title: The Book of Deuteronomy Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Deuteronomy — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: These be the words which Moses spake unto all Israel on this side Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain over against the Red sea, between Paran, and Tophel, and Laban, and Hazeroth, and Dizahab.
verses.decoded: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel on this side of the Jordan in the wilderness, in the plain opposite the Red Sea, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

verses.kjv: (There are eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of mount Seir unto Kadeshbarnea.)
verses.decoded: It is an eleven-day journey from Horeb by way of Mount Seir to Kadesh-barnea.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spake unto the children of Israel, according unto all that the LORD had given him in commandment unto them;
verses.decoded: And it happened in the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, that Moses spoke to the children of Israel, according to all that the LORD had commanded him for them;

verses.kjv: After he had slain Sihon the king of the Amorites, which dwelt in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, which dwelt at Astaroth in Edrei:
verses.decoded: After he had killed Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and Og, the king of Bashan, who lived in Astaroth in Edrei:

verses.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the land of Moab, began Moses to declare this law, saying,
verses.decoded: On the east side of the Jordan River, in the land of Moab, Moses began to explain this law, saying:

verses.kjv: The LORD our God spake unto us in Horeb, saying, Ye have dwelt long enough in this mount:
verses.decoded: The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, You have stayed long enough on this mountain:

verses.kjv: Turn you, and take your journey, and go to the mount of the Amorites, and unto all the places nigh thereunto, in the plain, in the hills, and in the vale, and in the south, and by the sea side, to the land of the Canaanites, and unto Lebanon, unto the great river, the river Euphrates.
verses.decoded: Go, and begin your journey, and proceed to the mountain region of the Amorites, and to all the places near it, in the plain, in the hills, in the valley, in the south, and along the coast, to the land of the Canaanites, and to Lebanon, to the great river, the Euphrates River.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have set the land before you: go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give unto them and to their seed after them.
verses.decoded: Look, I have placed the land before you: go in and take possession of the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, to give to them and to their descendants after them.

verses.kjv: And I spake unto you at that time, saying, I am not able to bear you myself alone:
verses.decoded: And I spoke to you at that time, saying, I am not able to carry you by myself alone.

verses.kjv: The LORD your God hath multiplied you, and, behold, ye are this day as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.decoded: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and look, you are today as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.kjv: (The LORD God of your fathers make you a thousand times so many more as ye are, and bless you, as he hath promised you!)
verses.decoded: The LORD God of your ancestors make you a thousand times more numerous than you are, and bless you, as he has promised you!

verses.kjv: How can I myself alone bear your cumbrance, and your burden, and your strife?
verses.decoded: How can I alone carry your troubles, your burdens, and your disputes?

verses.kjv: Take you wise men, and understanding, and known among your tribes, and I will make them rulers over you.
verses.decoded: Select wise and understanding men, who are recognized among your tribes, and I will appoint them as leaders over you.

verses.kjv: And ye answered me, and said, The thing which thou hast spoken is good for us to do.
verses.decoded: And you answered me and said, 'What you have spoken is good for us to do.'

verses.kjv: So I took the chief of your tribes, wise men, and known, and made them heads over you, captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, and captains over fifties, and captains over tens, and officers among your tribes.
verses.decoded: So I took the leaders of your tribes, wise and respected men, and appointed them as leaders over you, commanders of thousands, commanders of hundreds, commanders of fifties, commanders of tens, and officials among your tribes.

verses.kjv: And I charged your judges at that time, saying, Hear the causes between your brethren, and judge righteously between every man and his brother, and the stranger that is with him.
verses.decoded: And I commanded your judges at that time, saying, Listen to the cases between your relatives, and judge fairly between every person and their relative, and the foreigner who is with them.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not respect persons in judgment; but ye shall hear the small as well as the great; ye shall not be afraid of the face of man; for the judgment is God’s: and the cause that is too hard for you, bring it unto me, and I will hear it.
verses.decoded: You must not show favoritism in judgment; but you must hear the humble as well as the powerful; you must not be afraid of any person; because the judgment belongs to God: and if a case is too difficult for you, bring it to me, and I will hear it.

verses.kjv: And I commanded you at that time all the things which ye should do.
verses.decoded: And I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

verses.kjv: And when we departed from Horeb, we went through all that great and terrible wilderness, which ye saw by the way of the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadeshbarnea.
verses.decoded: And when we left Horeb, we traveled through all that vast and fearsome wilderness, which you saw on the way to the mountain of the Amorites, as the LORD our God instructed us; and we arrived at Kadeshbarnea.

verses.kjv: And I said unto you, Ye are come unto the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God doth give unto us.
verses.decoded: And I said to you, You have come to the mountain of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

verses.kjv: Behold, the LORD thy God hath set the land before thee: go up and possess it, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath said unto thee; fear not, neither be discouraged.
verses.decoded: Indeed, the LORD your God has placed the land before you: go up and take possession of it, as the LORD God of your ancestors has told you; do not be afraid, and do not be discouraged.

verses.kjv: And ye came near unto me every one of you, and said, We will send men before us, and they shall search us out the land, and bring us word again by what way we must go up, and into what cities we shall come.
verses.decoded: And you all came near to me and said, 'We will send men ahead of us, and they will explore the land for us and bring us back a report about which way we should go up and into which cities we should go.'

verses.kjv: And the saying pleased me well: and I took twelve men of you, one of a tribe:
verses.decoded: And the proposal pleased me greatly: and I selected twelve men from among you, one from each tribe.

verses.kjv: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came unto the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.
verses.decoded: And they turned and went up into the mountain, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and searched it out.

verses.kjv: And they took of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down unto us, and brought us word again, and said, It is a good land which the LORD our God doth give us.
verses.decoded: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands, and brought it down to us. They also brought us a report, saying, "It is a good land that the Lord our God is giving us."

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding ye would not go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God:
verses.decoded: However, you refused to go up, but instead rebelled against the command of the Lord your God:

verses.kjv: And ye murmured in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he hath brought us forth out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites, to destroy us.
verses.decoded: And you complained in your tents, and said, Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the power of the Amorites, to destroy us.

verses.kjv: Whither shall we go up? our brethren have discouraged our heart, saying, The people is greater and taller than we; the cities are great and walled up to heaven; and moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.
verses.decoded: Where are we to go? Our brothers have made us lose courage, saying, 'The people are larger and taller than we are; the cities are great and fortified up to the sky; and in addition, we have seen the sons of the Anakims there.'

verses.kjv: Then I said unto you, Dread not, neither be afraid of them.
verses.decoded: Then I said to you, 'Do not be terrified, nor be afraid of them.'

verses.kjv: The LORD your God which goeth before you, he shall fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes;
verses.decoded: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to everything he did for you in Egypt before your eyes.

verses.kjv: And in the wilderness, where thou hast seen how that the LORD thy God bare thee, as a man doth bear his son, in all the way that ye went, until ye came into this place.
verses.decoded: And in the wilderness, where you have seen how the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came into this place.

verses.kjv: Yet in this thing ye did not believe the LORD your God,
verses.decoded: However, in this matter, you did not trust the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: Who went in the way before you, to search you out a place to pitch your tents in, in fire by night, to shew you by what way ye should go, and in a cloud by day.
verses.decoded: Who went ahead of you on the journey, to find a place for you to set up your tents, with fire by night to show you which way you should go, and with a cloud by day.

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, and was wroth, and sware, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD heard your words, and became angry, and swore, saying,

verses.kjv: Surely there shall not one of these men of this evil generation see that good land, which I sware to give unto your fathers,
verses.decoded: Certainly, not one of these men from this wicked generation will see that good land, which I swore to give to your ancestors.

verses.kjv: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh; he shall see it, and to him will I give the land that he hath trodden upon, and to his children, because he hath wholly followed the LORD.
verses.decoded: Except for Caleb, the son of Jephunneh; he will see it, and to him I will give the land that he has walked upon, and to his children, because he has completely followed the LORD.

verses.kjv: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, Thou also shalt not go in thither.
verses.decoded: Also the LORD was angry with me because of you, saying, You also shall not go in there.

verses.kjv: But Joshua the son of Nun, which standeth before thee, he shall go in thither: encourage him: for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.
verses.decoded: However, Joshua, the son of Nun, who serves before you, he will go in there. Encourage him, because he will cause Israel to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: Moreover your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, and your children, which in that day had no knowledge between good and evil, they shall go in thither, and unto them will I give it, and they shall possess it.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, your little ones, whom you said would become plunder, and your children, who at that time had no knowledge of good and evil, they will go in there, and I will give it to them, and they will take possession of it.

verses.kjv: But as for you, turn you, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.decoded: But as for you, turn and travel into the wilderness by way of the Red Sea.

verses.kjv: Then ye answered and said unto me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when ye had girded on every man his weapons of war, ye were ready to go up into the hill.
verses.decoded: Then you answered and said to me, We have sinned against the LORD, we will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us. And when each man had put on his weapons of war, you were ready to go up into the hill.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Say unto them, Go not up, neither fight; for I am not among you; lest ye be smitten before your enemies.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to me, Tell them, Do not go up, nor fight; for I am not among you; so that you will not be defeated by your enemies.

verses.kjv: So I spake unto you; and ye would not hear, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and went presumptuously up into the hill.
verses.decoded: And I spoke to you; and you would not listen, but rebelled against the command of the LORD, and went defiantly up into the hill.

verses.kjv: And the Amorites, which dwelt in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, even unto Hormah.
verses.decoded: And the Amorites, who lived in that mountain, came out against you, and chased you, as bees do, and destroyed you in Seir, all the way to Hormah.

verses.kjv: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear unto you.
verses.decoded: And you returned and cried before the LORD; but the LORD would not listen to your voice, nor pay attention to you.

verses.kjv: So ye abode in Kadesh many days, according unto the days that ye abode there.
verses.decoded: So you remained in Kadesh for many days, according to the number of days you remained there.

verses.kjv: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea, as the LORD spake unto me: and we compassed mount Seir many days.
verses.decoded: Then we turned and began our journey into the wilderness by way of the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me, and we traveled around Mount Seir for many days.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to me, saying:

verses.kjv: Ye have compassed this mountain long enough: turn you northward.
verses.decoded: You have circled this mountain long enough; turn northward.

verses.kjv: And command thou the people, saying, Ye are to pass through the coast of your brethren the children of Esau, which dwell in Seir; and they shall be afraid of you: take ye good heed unto yourselves therefore:
verses.decoded: And command you the people, saying, 'You are to pass through the territory of your relatives, the descendants of Esau, who live in Seir; and they will be afraid of you.'

verses.kjv: Meddle not with them; for I will not give you of their land, no, not so much as a foot breadth; because I have given mount Seir unto Esau for a possession.
verses.decoded: Do not interfere with them, because I will not give you any of their land, not even a small piece; because I have given Mount Seir to Esau as a possession.

verses.kjv: Ye shall buy meat of them for money, that ye may eat; and ye shall also buy water of them for money, that ye may drink.
verses.decoded: You shall buy food from them with money, so that you may eat; and you shall also buy water from them with money, so that you may drink.

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God hath blessed thee in all the works of thy hand: he knoweth thy walking through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD thy God hath been with thee; thou hast lacked nothing.
verses.decoded: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hand: he knows your journey through this great wilderness: these forty years the LORD your God has been with you; you have lacked nothing.

verses.kjv: And when we passed by from our brethren the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, through the way of the plain from Elath, and from Eziongaber, we turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.
verses.decoded: And when we went past our relatives, the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, along the road of the plain from Elath and from Ezion-geber, we turned and went along the road of the wilderness of Moab.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Distress not the Moabites, neither contend with them in battle: for I will not give thee of their land for a possession; because I have given Ar unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to me, Do not harass the Moabites, and do not fight against them in battle, because I will not give you any of their land as a possession, for I have given Ar to the descendants of Lot as a possession.

verses.kjv: The Emims dwelt therein in times past, a people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims;
verses.decoded: The Emims lived there in the past, a great, numerous, and tall people, like the Anakims.

verses.kjv: Which also were accounted giants, as the Anakims; but the Moabites call them Emims.
verses.decoded: They were also considered giants, like the Anakim; but the Moabites called them Emim.

verses.kjv: The Horims also dwelt in Seir beforetime; but the children of Esau succeeded them, when they had destroyed them from before them, and dwelt in their stead; as Israel did unto the land of his possession, which the LORD gave unto them.
verses.decoded: The Horims also lived in Seir previously; but the descendants of Esau dispossessed them, after they had destroyed them from their presence and lived in their place; just as Israel did to the land of their possession, which the Lord gave to them.

verses.kjv: Now rise up, said I, and get you over the brook Zered. And we went over the brook Zered.
verses.decoded: Now get up, I said, and cross over the brook Zered. And we crossed over the brook Zered.

verses.kjv: And the space in which we came from Kadeshbarnea, until we were come over the brook Zered, was thirty and eight years; until all the generation of the men of war were wasted out from among the host, as the LORD sware unto them.
verses.decoded: And the time it took us to travel from Kadeshbarnea, until we had crossed over the Zered Brook, was thirty-eight years; until the entire generation of fighting men had perished from the camp, as the LORD had sworn to them.

verses.kjv: For indeed the hand of the LORD was against them, to destroy them from among the host, until they were consumed.
verses.decoded: Certainly, the Lord's power was against them, to destroy them from among the company, until they were eliminated.

verses.kjv: So it came to pass, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,
verses.decoded: So it happened, when all the soldiers had perished and died from among the people,

verses.kjv: That the LORD spake unto me, saying,
verses.decoded: That the LORD spoke to me, saying,

verses.kjv: Thou art to pass over through Ar, the coast of Moab, this day:
verses.decoded: You are to pass through Ar, the border of Moab, today.

verses.kjv: And when thou comest nigh over against the children of Ammon, distress them not, nor meddle with them: for I will not give thee of the land of the children of Ammon any possession; because I have given it unto the children of Lot for a possession.
verses.decoded: And when you come near the descendants of Ammon, do not trouble them or interfere with them, because I will not give you any of the land of the descendants of Ammon as a possession, for I have given it to the descendants of Lot as a possession.

verses.kjv: (That also was accounted a land of giants: giants dwelt therein in old time; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;
verses.decoded: (That also was considered a land of giants: giants lived there in ancient times; and the Ammonites call them Zamzummims;

verses.kjv: A people great, and many, and tall, as the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead:
verses.decoded: A people who were great, numerous, and tall, like the Anakims; but the LORD destroyed them before them; and they took their place and lived in their land.

verses.kjv: As he did to the children of Esau, which dwelt in Seir, when he destroyed the Horims from before them; and they succeeded them, and dwelt in their stead even unto this day:
verses.decoded: Just as he did for the descendants of Esau, who lived in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and the descendants of Esau took possession of their land and have lived there until this day.

verses.kjv: And the Avims which dwelt in Hazerim, even unto Azzah, the Caphtorims, which came forth out of Caphtor, destroyed them, and dwelt in their stead.)
verses.decoded: And the Avims, who lived in Hazerim, even as far as Azzah, were destroyed by the Caphtorims, who came from Caphtor, and the Caphtorims then lived in their place.

verses.kjv: Rise ye up, take your journey, and pass over the river Arnon: behold, I have given into thine hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land: begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.
verses.decoded: Rise up, take your journey, and cross over the Arnon River. Understand that I have given Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land into your possession. Begin to take possession of it and fight him in battle.

verses.kjv: This day will I begin to put the dread of thee and the fear of thee upon the nations that are under the whole heaven, who shall hear report of thee, and shall tremble, and be in anguish because of thee.
verses.decoded: Today I will begin to instill the dread of you and the fear of you upon the nations under the entire sky, who will hear reports about you, and will tremble, and be in distress because of you.

verses.kjv: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth unto Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,
verses.decoded: And I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

verses.kjv: Let me pass through thy land: I will go along by the high way, I will neither turn unto the right hand nor to the left.
verses.decoded: Let me pass through your land: I will go along the main road; I will not turn to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt sell me meat for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink: only I will pass through on my feet;
verses.decoded: You must sell me food for money, so that I may eat; and give me water for money, so that I may drink: I will only pass through on my feet;

verses.kjv: (As the children of Esau which dwell in Seir, and the Moabites which dwell in Ar, did unto me;) until I shall pass over Jordan into the land which the LORD our God giveth us.
verses.decoded: Just as the descendants of Esau who live in Seir, and the Moabites who live in Ar, did for me, until I cross the Jordan River into the land that the LORD our God gives us.

verses.kjv: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him: for the LORD thy God hardened his spirit, and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into thy hand, as appeareth this day.
verses.decoded: But Sihon, king of Heshbon, would not allow us to pass by him, because the LORD your God made his spirit stubborn and made his heart unyielding, so that he could hand him over to you, as is evident today.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Behold, I have begun to give Sihon and his land before thee: begin to possess, that thou mayest inherit his land.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to me, Look, I have begun to give Sihon and his land to you: begin to take possession, so that you may inherit his land.

verses.kjv: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
verses.decoded: Then Sihon came out to confront us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.

verses.kjv: And the LORD our God delivered him before us; and we smote him, and his sons, and all his people.
verses.decoded: And the Lord our God handed him over to us; and we defeated him, and his sons, and all his people.

verses.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed the men, and the women, and the little ones, of every city, we left none to remain:
verses.decoded: And we captured all his cities at that time, and completely destroyed the men, and the women, and the children of every city; we left no one alive.

verses.kjv: Only the cattle we took for a prey unto ourselves, and the spoil of the cities which we took.
verses.decoded: We took only the livestock as plunder for ourselves, and the plunder from the cities that we captured.

verses.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the brink of the river of Arnon, and from the city that is by the river, even unto Gilead, there was not one city too strong for us: the LORD our God delivered all unto us:
verses.decoded: From Aroer, which is at the edge of the Arnon River, and from the city that is by the river, even to Gilead, not one city was too strong for us; the Lord our God delivered all to us.

verses.kjv: Only unto the land of the children of Ammon thou camest not, nor unto any place of the river Jabbok, nor unto the cities in the mountains, nor unto whatsoever the LORD our God forbad us.
verses.decoded: However, you did not go near the land of the Ammonites, nor to any place along the Jabbok River, nor to the cities in the mountains, nor to anything else that the LORD our God prohibited us from approaching.

verses.kjv: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan: and Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.
verses.decoded: Then we turned and went up the road to Bashan; and Og, the king of Bashan, came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Edrei.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Fear him not: for I will deliver him, and all his people, and his land, into thy hand; and thou shalt do unto him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to me, Do not fear him, because I will hand him, all his people, and his land over to you; and you will do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon.

verses.kjv: So the LORD our God delivered into our hands Og also, the king of Bashan, and all his people: and we smote him until none was left to him remaining.
verses.decoded: So the Lord our God handed over to us Og as well, the king of Bashan, and all his people. And we defeated him until no one was left alive from his forces.

verses.kjv: And we took all his cities at that time, there was not a city which we took not from them, threescore cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.decoded: And we captured all his cities at that time; there was not a city that we did not take from them, sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.kjv: All these cities were fenced with high walls, gates, and bars; beside unwalled towns a great many.
verses.decoded: All these cities were fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many unwalled towns.

verses.kjv: And we utterly destroyed them, as we did unto Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying the men, women, and children, of every city.
verses.decoded: And we completely destroyed them, just as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, completely destroying the men, women, and children of every city.

verses.kjv: But all the cattle, and the spoil of the cities, we took for a prey to ourselves.
verses.decoded: But all the livestock, and the plunder from the cities, we took as loot for ourselves.

verses.kjv: And we took at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side Jordan, from the river of Arnon unto mount Hermon;
verses.decoded: And at that time, we took from the two kings of the Amorites the land that was on this side of the Jordan River, from the Arnon River to Mount Hermon.

verses.kjv: (Which Hermon the Sidonians call Sirion; and the Amorites call it Shenir;)
verses.decoded: Hermon, which the Sidonians call Sirion, and the Amorites call Shenir,

verses.kjv: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, unto Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.
verses.decoded: All the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salchah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

verses.kjv: For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of giants; behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon? nine cubits was the length thereof, and four cubits the breadth of it, after the cubit of a man.
verses.decoded: Because only Og, king of Bashan, was the only one left of the remaining giants; look, his bed was made of iron; is it not in Rabbath of the children of Ammon?

verses.kjv: And this land, which we possessed at that time, from Aroer, which is by the river Arnon, and half mount Gilead, and the cities thereof, gave I unto the Reubenites and to the Gadites.
verses.decoded: And this land, which we took possession of at that time, from Aroer, which is by the Arnon River, and half of Mount Gilead, and its cities, I gave to.

verses.kjv: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, being the kingdom of Og, gave I unto the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.
verses.decoded: And the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, which was the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half tribe of Manasseh; all the region of Argob, with all Bashan, which was called the land of giants.

verses.kjv: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the country of Argob unto the coasts of Geshuri and Maachathi; and called them after his own name, Bashanhavothjair, unto this day.
verses.decoded: Jair, the son of Manasseh, took all the country of Argob up to the borders of Geshuri and Maachathi; and he named them after himself, Bashan-havoth-jair, until this day.

verses.kjv: And I gave Gilead unto Machir.
verses.decoded: And I gave Gilead to Machir.

verses.kjv: And unto the Reubenites and unto the Gadites I gave from Gilead even unto the river Arnon half the valley, and the border even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
verses.decoded: And to the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead as far as the Arnon River half of the valley, and the border as far as the Jabbok River, which is the border of the Ammonites.

verses.kjv: The plain also, and Jordan, and the coast thereof, from Chinnereth even unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea, under Ashdothpisgah eastward.
verses.decoded: Also the plain, and the Jordan River, and its surrounding area, from Chinnereth as far as the Sea of the Plain, which is the Salt Sea, below the slopes of Pisgah to the east.

verses.kjv: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God hath given you this land to possess it: ye shall pass over armed before your brethren the children of Israel, all that are meet for the war.
verses.decoded: And I commanded you at that time, saying, The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it: you shall cross over armed before your relatives, the children of Israel, all who are fit for war.

verses.kjv: But your wives, and your little ones, and your cattle, (for I know that ye have much cattle,) shall abide in your cities which I have given you;
verses.decoded: But your wives, and your children, and your livestock, (for I know that you have much livestock,) shall remain in your cities which I have given you.

verses.kjv: Until the LORD have given rest unto your brethren, as well as unto you, and until they also possess the land which the LORD your God hath given them beyond Jordan: and then shall ye return every man unto his possession, which I have given you.
verses.decoded: Until the LORD has given rest to your relatives, as well as to you, and until they also take possession of the land which the LORD your God has given them.

verses.kjv: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Thine eyes have seen all that the LORD your God hath done unto these two kings: so shall the LORD do unto all the kingdoms whither thou passest.
verses.decoded: And I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings: so the LORD will do to all the kingdoms where you go.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not fear them: for the LORD your God he shall fight for you.
verses.decoded: You must not fear them, because the LORD your God will fight for you.

verses.kjv: And I besought the LORD at that time, saying,
verses.decoded: And I pleaded with the LORD at that time, saying,

verses.kjv: O Lord GOD, thou hast begun to shew thy servant thy greatness, and thy mighty hand: for what God is there in heaven or in earth, that can do according to thy works, and according to thy might?
verses.decoded: O Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness and your mighty hand, for what God is there in heaven or on earth who can do according to your works and according to your might?

verses.kjv: I pray thee, let me go over, and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that goodly mountain, and Lebanon.
verses.decoded: I ask you, let me cross over and see the good land that is beyond Jordan, that beautiful mountain, and Lebanon.

verses.kjv: But the LORD was wroth with me for your sakes, and would not hear me: and the LORD said unto me, Let it suffice thee; speak no more unto me of this matter.
verses.decoded: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and would not listen to me. And the LORD said to me, Let that be enough for you; do not speak to me anymore about this matter.

verses.kjv: Get thee up into the top of Pisgah, and lift up thine eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and behold it with thine eyes: for thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.decoded: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift your eyes to the west, north, south, and east, and see it with your eyes, because you will not go over this Jordan.

verses.kjv: But charge Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him: for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which thou shalt see.
verses.decoded: But instruct Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him, because he will cross over before these people, and he will enable them to inherit the land which you will see.

verses.kjv: So we abode in the valley over against Bethpeor.
verses.decoded: So we stayed in the valley opposite Bethpeor.

verses.kjv: Now therefore hearken, O Israel, unto the statutes and unto the judgments, which I teach you, for to do them, that ye may live, and go in and possess the land which the LORD God of your fathers giveth you.
verses.decoded: So now, listen, Israel, to the laws and rules that I am teaching you to follow, so that you may live and go in and take possession of the land.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verses.decoded: You must not add to the word that I command you, nor shall you take anything away from it, so that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baalpeor: for all the men that followed Baalpeor, the LORD thy God hath destroyed them from among you.
verses.decoded: Your eyes have seen what the Lord did because of Baalpeor: for all the men who followed Baalpeor, the Lord your God has destroyed them from among you.

verses.kjv: But ye that did cleave unto the LORD your God are alive every one of you this day.
verses.decoded: But you who remained loyal to the LORD your God are all alive today.

verses.kjv: Behold, I have taught you statutes and judgments, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that ye should do so in the land whither ye go to possess it.
verses.decoded: Indeed, I have taught you statutes and judgments, just as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the land where you go to possess it.

verses.kjv: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the nations, which shall hear all these statutes, and say, Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.
verses.decoded: Therefore, observe and follow them; because this is your wisdom and your understanding in the eyes of the nations, who will hear all these laws and say, 'Certainly, this great nation is a wise and understanding people.'

verses.kjv: For what nation is there so great, who hath God so nigh unto them, as the LORD our God is in all things that we call upon him for?
verses.decoded: What great nation is there that has God so near them, as the Lord our God is in everything we call upon him for?

verses.kjv: And what nation is there so great, that hath statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you this day?
verses.decoded: And what nation is there so great, that has statutes and judgments so righteous as all this law, which I set before you today?

verses.kjv: Only take heed to thyself, and keep thy soul diligently, lest thou forget the things which thine eyes have seen, and lest they depart from thy heart all the days of thy life: but teach them thy sons, and thy sons’ sons;
verses.decoded: Only be careful, and diligently guard yourself, so that you do not forget the things that your eyes have seen, and so that they do not fade from your memory all the days of your life; but teach them to your children and your grandchildren.

verses.kjv: Specially the day that thou stoodest before the LORD thy God in Horeb, when the LORD said unto me, Gather me the people together, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they shall live upon the earth, and that they may teach their children.
verses.decoded: Especially the day that you stood before the LORD your God at Horeb, when the LORD said to me, Assemble the people for me, and I will let them hear my words, so that they may learn to revere me all the days that they live on the earth, and so that they may teach their children.

verses.kjv: And ye came near and stood under the mountain; and the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven, with darkness, clouds, and thick darkness.
verses.decoded: And you came close and stood at the foot of the mountain; and the mountain was burning with fire up to the heart of the sky, with gloom, clouds, and dense darkness.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto you out of the midst of the fire: ye heard the voice of the words, but saw no similitude; only ye heard a voice.
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to you from the middle of the fire: you heard the sound of the words, but saw no form; only you heard a voice.

verses.kjv: And he declared unto you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even ten commandments; and he wrote them upon two tables of stone.
verses.decoded: And he revealed to you his agreement, which he instructed you to obey, specifically the Ten Commandments; and he inscribed them on two stone tablets.

verses.kjv: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and judgments, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go over to possess it.
verses.decoded: And the LORD commanded me at that time to teach you laws and rules, so that you might do them in the land where you are going to cross over to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: Take ye therefore good heed unto yourselves; for ye saw no manner of similitude on the day that the LORD spake unto you in Horeb out of the midst of the fire:
verses.decoded: Therefore, be very careful, because you did not see any form or likeness on the day that the Lord spoke to you in Horeb from the middle of the fire.

verses.kjv: Lest ye corrupt yourselves, and make you a graven image, the similitude of any figure, the likeness of male or female,
verses.decoded: So that you do not corrupt yourselves, and make for yourselves a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of a male or female.

verses.kjv: The likeness of any beast that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged fowl that flieth in the air,
verses.decoded: The image of any animal that is on the earth, the image of any winged bird that flies in the air,

verses.kjv: The likeness of any thing that creepeth on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.decoded: The image of anything that crawls on the ground, the image of any fish that is in the waters beneath the earth.

verses.kjv: And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which the LORD thy God hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.
verses.decoded: And so that you do not lift your eyes to heaven, and when you see the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the heavenly bodies, you should not be compelled to worship them and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all nations under the entire heaven.

verses.kjv: But the LORD hath taken you, and brought you forth out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be unto him a people of inheritance, as ye are this day.
verses.decoded: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, even out of Egypt, to be for him a people of inheritance, as you are this day.

verses.kjv: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and sware that I should not go over Jordan, and that I should not go in unto that good land, which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance:
verses.decoded: Moreover, the Lord was angry with me because of you, and he swore that I would not cross the Jordan River, and that I would not enter that good land which the Lord your God is giving you as an inheritance.

verses.kjv: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but ye shall go over, and possess that good land.
verses.decoded: But I must die in this land, I must not go over Jordan: but you shall go over, and possess that good land.

verses.kjv: Take heed unto yourselves, lest ye forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make you a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, which the LORD thy God hath forbidden thee.
verses.decoded: Be careful, so that you do not forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make for yourselves a carved image, or the likeness of anything.

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.
verses.decoded: For the LORD your God is a consuming fire, even a jealous God.

verses.kjv: When thou shalt beget children, and children’s children, and ye shall have remained long in the land, and shall corrupt yourselves, and make a graven image, or the likeness of any thing, and shall do evil in the sight of the LORD thy God, to provoke him to anger:
verses.decoded: When you have children and grandchildren, and you have lived in the land for a long time, and you corrupt yourselves by making an idol, or the likeness of anything, and you do evil in the sight of the LORD your God, to provoke him to anger:

verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day, that ye shall soon utterly perish from off the land whereunto ye go over Jordan to possess it; ye shall not prolong your days upon it, but shall utterly be destroyed.
verses.decoded: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon completely disappear from the land that you are crossing the Jordan River to take possession of.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter you among the nations, and ye shall be left few in number among the heathen, whither the LORD shall lead you.
verses.decoded: And the Lord will scatter you among the nations, and you will be left few in number among the people, to wherever the Lord will lead you.

verses.kjv: And there ye shall serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.
verses.decoded: And there you will serve gods, the work of human hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

verses.kjv: But if from thence thou shalt seek the LORD thy God, thou shalt find him, if thou seek him with all thy heart and with all thy soul.
verses.decoded: But if from there you seek the LORD your God, you will find him, if you seek him with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.kjv: When thou art in tribulation, and all these things are come upon thee, even in the latter days, if thou turn to the LORD thy God, and shalt be obedient unto his voice;
verses.decoded: When you are in distress, and all these things have happened to you, even in the last days, if you turn to the LORD your God, and obey his voice.

verses.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a merciful God;) he will not forsake thee, neither destroy thee, nor forget the covenant of thy fathers which he sware unto them.
verses.decoded: (For the LORD your God is a merciful God;) he will not abandon you, nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

verses.kjv: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before thee, since the day that God created man upon the earth, and ask from the one side of heaven unto the other, whether there hath been any such thing as this great thing is, or hath been heard like it?
verses.decoded: For ask now about the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created humanity on the earth, and ask from one side of heaven to the other, whether there has been any such thing as this great matter, or has been heard like it?

verses.kjv: Did ever people hear the voice of God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as thou hast heard, and live?
verses.decoded: Did any people ever hear the voice of God speaking from the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

verses.kjv: Or hath God assayed to go and take him a nation from the midst of another nation, by temptations, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a stretched out arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
verses.decoded: Or has God attempted to go and take for himself a nation from among another nation, by trials, by signs, and by wonders, and by war, and by a mighty hand, and by a powerful arm, and by great acts of terror, according to all that the Lord your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

verses.kjv: Unto thee it was shewed, that thou mightest know that the LORD he is God; there is none else beside him.
verses.decoded: To you it was shown, so that you would know that the LORD is God; there is no other besides him.

verses.kjv: Out of heaven he made thee to hear his voice, that he might instruct thee: and upon earth he shewed thee his great fire; and thou heardest his words out of the midst of the fire.
verses.decoded: From heaven he caused you to hear his voice, so that he could instruct you; and on earth he showed you his great fire; and you heard his words from the middle of the fire.

verses.kjv: And because he loved thy fathers, therefore he chose their seed after them, and brought thee out in his sight with his mighty power out of Egypt;
verses.decoded: Because he loved your ancestors, he therefore chose their descendants after them, and personally brought you out from Egypt with his great power.

verses.kjv: To drive out nations from before thee greater and mightier than thou art, to bring thee in, to give thee their land for an inheritance, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: To drive out nations from before you, nations greater and mightier than you are, to bring you in, to give you their land as an inheritance, as it is this day.

verses.kjv: Know therefore this day, and consider it in thine heart, that the LORD he is God in heaven above, and upon the earth beneath: there is none else.
verses.decoded: Therefore know this day, and consider it in your heart, that the LORD is God in heaven above and on the earth below: there is no one else.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt keep therefore his statutes, and his commandments, which I command thee this day, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, and that thou mayest prolong thy days upon the earth, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, for ever.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you shall keep his statutes and his commandments, which I command you this day, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and so that you may prolong your days upon the earth, which the LORD your God gives you, forever.

verses.kjv: Then Moses severed three cities on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.decoded: Then Moses set aside three cities on this side of the Jordan toward the sunrise;

verses.kjv: That the slayer might flee thither, which should kill his neighbour unawares, and hated him not in times past; and that fleeing unto one of these cities he might live:
verses.decoded: So that the killer could flee there, who kills their neighbor by accident, and had not previously hated them; and that by fleeing to one of these cities they could live.

verses.kjv: Namely, Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, of the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, of the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, of the Manassites.
verses.decoded: Specifically, Bezer in the wilderness, in the flat land, belonging to the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead, belonging to the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan, belonging to the Manassites.

verses.kjv: And this is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel:
verses.decoded: And this is the law that Moses presented to the people of Israel:

verses.kjv: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spake unto the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt,
verses.decoded: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which Moses spoke to the children of Israel, after they came forth out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: On this side Jordan, in the valley over against Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel smote, after they were come forth out of Egypt:
verses.decoded: Beyond the Jordan River, in the valley opposite Bethpeor, in the land of Sihon, king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, whom Moses and the people of Israel defeated, after they had come out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And they possessed his land, and the land of Og king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, which were on this side Jordan toward the sunrising;
verses.decoded: And they took possession of his land, and the land of Og, king of Bashan, two kings of the Amorites, who were on this side of the Jordan toward the sunrise.

verses.kjv: From Aroer, which is by the bank of the river Arnon, even unto mount Sion, which is Hermon,
verses.decoded: And from Aroer, which is by the bank of the Arnon River, up to Mount Sion, which is Hermon.

verses.kjv: And all the plain on this side Jordan eastward, even unto the sea of the plain, under the springs of Pisgah.
verses.decoded: And all the plain on this side of the Jordan to the east, extending to the sea of the plain, which is the Salt Sea, under Ashdothpisgah.

verses.kjv: And Moses called all Israel, and said unto them, Hear, O Israel, the statutes and judgments which I speak in your ears this day, that ye may learn them, and keep, and do them.
verses.decoded: And Moses summoned all of Israel and said to them, 'Listen, O Israel, the laws and rules that I am speaking to you today, so that you may learn them, and observe and follow them.'

verses.kjv: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.
verses.decoded: The Lord our God established a solemn agreement with us at Horeb.

verses.kjv: The LORD made not this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive this day.
verses.decoded: The LORD did not make this covenant with our ancestors, but with us, specifically us, who are all of us here alive today.

verses.kjv: The LORD talked with you face to face in the mount out of the midst of the fire,
verses.decoded: The Lord spoke with you face to face on the mountain from the middle of the fire.

verses.kjv: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to shew you the word of the LORD: for ye were afraid by reason of the fire, and went not up into the mount;) saying,
verses.decoded: I stood between the Lord and you at that time, to declare to you the word of the Lord: for you were afraid because of the fire, and did not go up into the mountain.

verses.kjv: I am the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.decoded: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the house of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have none other gods before me.
verses.decoded: You shall have no other gods besides me.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not make thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the waters beneath the earth:
verses.decoded: You shall not make for yourself any carved image, or any representation of anything that is in the sky above, or that is on the earth below, or that is in the waters under the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not bow down thyself unto them, nor serve them: for I the LORD thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me,
verses.decoded: You shall not bow down yourself to them, nor serve them: for I the LORD your God am a jealous God, punishing the wrongdoing of the fathers on the children to the third and fourth generation of those who hate me,

verses.kjv: And shewing mercy unto thousands of them that love me and keep my commandments.
verses.decoded: And showing mercy to thousands of those who love me and obey my commands.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not take the name of the LORD thy God in vain: for the LORD will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.
verses.decoded: You shall not take the name of the LORD your God in vain, because the LORD will not consider him innocent who takes his name in vain.

verses.kjv: Keep the sabbath day to sanctify it, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee.
verses.decoded: Observe the Sabbath day to keep it holy, as the Lord your God has commanded you.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt labour, and do all thy work:
verses.decoded: For six days you shall labor and do all your work:

verses.kjv: But the seventh day is the sabbath of the LORD thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, nor thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thine ox, nor thine ass, nor any of thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates; that thy manservant and thy maidservant may rest as well as thou.
verses.decoded: But the seventh day is the Sabbath of the LORD your God: on it you shall not do any work, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your cattle, nor the foreigner who is within your gates; so that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

verses.kjv: And remember that thou wast a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD thy God brought thee out thence through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm: therefore the LORD thy God commanded thee to keep the sabbath day.
verses.decoded: And remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and that the LORD your God brought you out from there through a mighty hand and by a stretched out arm; therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

verses.kjv: Honour thy father and thy mother, as the LORD thy God hath commanded thee; that thy days may be prolonged, and that it may go well with thee, in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.decoded: Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God has commanded you; so that your days may be long, and that it may go well with you, in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not kill.
verses.decoded: You must not kill.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou commit adultery.
verses.decoded: You shall not commit adultery.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou steal.
verses.decoded: Neither shall you steal.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou bear false witness against thy neighbour.
verses.decoded: You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou desire thy neighbour’s wife, neither shalt thou covet thy neighbour’s house, his field, or his manservant, or his maidservant, his ox, or his ass, or any thing that is thy neighbour’s.
verses.decoded: You shall not desire your neighbor's wife, nor shall you covet your neighbor's house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that belongs to your neighbor.

verses.kjv: These words the LORD spake unto all your assembly in the mount out of the midst of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice: and he added no more. And he wrote them in two tables of stone, and delivered them unto me.
verses.decoded: The LORD spoke these words to your entire assembly on the mountain from the middle of the fire, the cloud, and the thick darkness, with a loud voice; and he added nothing more. And he wrote them on two stone tablets and gave them to me.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when ye heard the voice out of the midst of the darkness, (for the mountain did burn with fire,) that ye came near unto me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;
verses.decoded: And it happened, when you heard the voice from the middle of the darkness (because the mountain was burning with fire), that you came near to me, all the leaders of your tribes and your elders.

verses.kjv: And ye said, Behold, the LORD our God hath shewed us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the midst of the fire: we have seen this day that God doth talk with man, and he liveth.
verses.decoded: And you said, Indeed, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice from the middle of the fire: we have seen today that God does talk with man, and he lives.

verses.kjv: Now therefore why should we die? for this great fire will consume us: if we hear the voice of the LORD our God any more, then we shall die.
verses.decoded: So why should we die? because this great fire will destroy us: if we continue to hear the voice of the Lord our God, then we will die.

verses.kjv: For who is there of all flesh, that hath heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the midst of the fire, as we have, and lived?
verses.decoded: For who among all people has heard the voice of the living God speaking from the middle of the fire, as we have, and survived?

verses.kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
verses.decoded: Come near and listen to everything that the Lord our God says; and you speak to us everything that the Lord our God speaks to you; and we will listen to it and do it.

verses.kjv: And the LORD heard the voice of your words, when ye spake unto me; and the LORD said unto me, I have heard the voice of the words of this people, which they have spoken unto thee: they have well said all that they have spoken.
verses.decoded: And the Lord heard your words when you spoke to me, and the Lord said to me, I have heard the words of these people.

verses.kjv: O that there were such an heart in them, that they would fear me, and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them, and with their children for ever!
verses.decoded: If only they had such a heart within them, that they would respect me and always obey all my commands, so that it might go well with them and with their children forever!

verses.kjv: Go say to them, Get you into your tents again.
verses.decoded: Go tell them to return to their tents.

verses.kjv: But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess it.
verses.decoded: But as for you, stand here by me, and I will speak to you all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which you shall observe to do in the land which I give them to possess.

verses.kjv: Ye shall observe to do therefore as the LORD your God hath commanded you: ye shall not turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
verses.decoded: You must therefore be careful to do as the Lord your God has commanded you; you must not deviate to the right or to the left.

verses.kjv: Ye shall walk in all the ways which the LORD your God hath commanded you, that ye may live, and that it may be well with you, and that ye may prolong your days in the land which ye shall possess.
verses.decoded: You shall walk in all the ways that the LORD your God has commanded you, so that you may live, and that it may be well with you, and that you may prolong your days in the land that you shall possess.

verses.kjv: Now these are the commandments, the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, that ye might do them in the land whither ye go to possess it:
verses.decoded: Now these are the commands, the regulations, and the decisions, which the LORD your God commanded to teach you, so that you may obey them in the land where you are going to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: That thou mightest fear the LORD thy God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command thee, thou, and thy son, and thy son’s son, all the days of thy life; and that thy days may be prolonged.
verses.decoded: So that you might fear the LORD your God, to keep all his statutes and his commandments, which I command you, you, and your son, and your grandson, all the days of your life; and that your days may be prolonged.

verses.kjv: Hear therefore, O Israel, and observe to do it; that it may be well with thee, and that ye may increase mightily, as the LORD God of thy fathers hath promised thee, in the land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.decoded: Therefore, listen, O Israel, and be careful to do it, so that it may go well with you, and that you may greatly multiply, as the LORD God of your ancestors has promised you, in the land that flows with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD:
verses.decoded: Listen, Israel: The LORD our God is one LORD.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy might.
verses.decoded: You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your might.

verses.kjv: And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:
verses.decoded: And these words, which I command you today, shall be in your heart:

verses.kjv: And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.decoded: And you shall teach them diligently to your children, and you shall talk about them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way,

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bind them for a sign upon thine hand, and they shall be as frontlets between thine eyes.
verses.decoded: And you shall tie them as a symbol on your hand, and they shall be like headbands between your eyes.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the posts of thy house, and on thy gates.
verses.decoded: And you shall write them on the doorposts of your house, and on your gates.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when the LORD thy God shall have brought thee into the land which he sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give thee great and goodly cities, which thou buildedst not,
verses.decoded: And it shall be, when the LORD your God shall have brought you into the land which he swore to your ancestors, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give you great and good cities, which you did not build,

verses.kjv: And houses full of all good things, which thou filledst not, and wells digged, which thou diggedst not, vineyards and olive trees, which thou plantedst not; when thou shalt have eaten and be full;
verses.decoded: And houses full of all good things, which you did not fill, and wells dug, which you did not dig, vineyards and olive trees, which you did not plant;

verses.kjv: Then beware lest thou forget the LORD, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.decoded: Then be careful not to forget the LORD, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the place of slavery.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God, and serve him, and shalt swear by his name.
verses.decoded: You shall fear the LORD your God, and serve him, and shall swear by his name.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not go after other gods, of the gods of the people which are round about you;
verses.decoded: You must not follow other gods, from the gods of the peoples who are around you.

verses.kjv: (For the LORD thy God is a jealous God among you) lest the anger of the LORD thy God be kindled against thee, and destroy thee from off the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: For the LORD your God is a jealous God among you; otherwise, the anger of the LORD your God may be ignited against you, and he may destroy you from the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not tempt the LORD your God, as ye tempted him in Massah.
verses.decoded: You must not test the Lord your God, as you tested him in Massah.

verses.kjv: Ye shall diligently keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he hath commanded thee.
verses.decoded: You must diligently observe the commands of the LORD your God, and his testimonies, and his statutes, which he has commanded you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt do that which is right and good in the sight of the LORD: that it may be well with thee, and that thou mayest go in and possess the good land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers,
verses.decoded: And you shall do what is right and good in the sight of the LORD, so that it may go well with you, and that you may enter and take possession of the good land which the LORD swore to your ancestors,

verses.kjv: To cast out all thine enemies from before thee, as the LORD hath spoken.
verses.decoded: To drive out all your enemies from before you, as the LORD has spoken.

verses.kjv: And when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What mean the testimonies, and the statutes, and the judgments, which the LORD our God hath commanded you?
verses.decoded: And when your son asks you in the future, saying, 'What is the meaning of the decrees, the statutes, and the regulations that the LORD our God has commanded you?'

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt say unto thy son, We were Pharaoh’s bondmen in Egypt; and the LORD brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:
verses.decoded: Then you shall say to your son, 'We were slaves to Pharaoh in Egypt; and the Lord brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand:'

verses.kjv: And the LORD shewed signs and wonders, great and sore, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:
verses.decoded: And the Lord showed signs and wonders, great and severe, upon Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his household, before our eyes:

verses.kjv: And he brought us out from thence, that he might bring us in, to give us the land which he sware unto our fathers.
verses.decoded: And he brought us out from there, so that he could bring us in and give us the land which he promised to our ancestors.

verses.kjv: And the LORD commanded us to do all these statutes, to fear the LORD our God, for our good always, that he might preserve us alive, as it is at this day.
verses.decoded: And the Lord commanded us to obey all these laws, to revere the Lord our God, for our lasting good, so that he might keep us alive, as it is today.

verses.kjv: And it shall be our righteousness, if we observe to do all these commandments before the LORD our God, as he hath commanded us.
verses.decoded: And it will be considered our righteousness if we carefully follow all these commands before the Lord our God, just as he has instructed us.

verses.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall bring thee into the land whither thou goest to possess it, and hath cast out many nations before thee, the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, seven nations greater and mightier than thou;
verses.decoded: When the LORD your God brings you into the land where you are going to take possession of it, and has driven out many nations before you—the Hittites, and the Girgashites, and the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites—seven nations greater and mightier than you;

verses.kjv: And when the LORD thy God shall deliver them before thee; thou shalt smite them, and utterly destroy them; thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them:
verses.decoded: And when the LORD your God delivers them to you, you shall strike them and completely destroy them. You shall make no agreement with them, nor show them any mercy.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.
verses.decoded: You must not intermarry with them; you must not give your daughter to his son, nor take his daughter for your son.

verses.kjv: For they will turn away thy son from following me, that they may serve other gods: so will the anger of the LORD be kindled against you, and destroy thee suddenly.
verses.decoded: Because they will turn your son away from following me, so that he may serve other gods; then the anger of the LORD will be ignited against you and destroy you suddenly.

verses.kjv: But thus shall ye deal with them; ye shall destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their groves, and burn their graven images with fire.
verses.decoded: But this is how you must deal with them: you must destroy their altars, and break down their images, and cut down their sacred poles, and burn their carved images with fire.

verses.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God: the LORD thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself, above all people that are upon the face of the earth.
verses.decoded: Because you are a holy people to the LORD your God: the LORD your God has chosen you to be a special people for himself, above all people who are on the face of the earth.

verses.kjv: The LORD did not set his love upon you, nor choose you, because ye were more in number than any people; for ye were the fewest of all people:
verses.decoded: The Lord did not set his affection on you, nor choose you, because you were more numerous than any other people; for you were the fewest of all people.

verses.kjv: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the oath which he had sworn unto your fathers, hath the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and redeemed you out of the house of bondmen, from the hand of Pharaoh king of Egypt.
verses.decoded: But because the LORD loved you, and because he would keep the promise which he had made to your ancestors, the LORD brought you out with a mighty hand, and rescued you from the place of slavery, from the power of Pharaoh king of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Know therefore that the LORD thy God, he is God, the faithful God, which keepeth covenant and mercy with them that love him and keep his commandments to a thousand generations;
verses.decoded: Therefore understand that the Lord your God, he is God, the faithful God, who keeps his agreement and compassion with those who love him and obey his commands.

verses.kjv: And repayeth them that hate him to their face, to destroy them: he will not be slack to him that hateth him, he will repay him to his face.
verses.decoded: And repays those who hate him directly, to destroy them: he will not delay for anyone who hates him, he will repay them directly.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do them.
verses.decoded: You shall therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command you today, to do them.

verses.kjv: Wherefore it shall come to pass, if ye hearken to these judgments, and keep, and do them, that the LORD thy God shall keep unto thee the covenant and the mercy which he sware unto thy fathers:
verses.decoded: And it will happen, if you pay attention to these commands, and keep and perform them, that the LORD your God will keep for you the covenant and the mercy which he swore to your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And he will love thee, and bless thee, and multiply thee: he will also bless the fruit of thy womb, and the fruit of thy land, thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep, in the land which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.decoded: And he will love you, and bless you, and make you numerous: he will also bless the offspring from your body, and the produce of your land, your grain, and your wine, and your oil, the offspring of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep, in the land which he swore to your ancestors to give you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt be blessed above all people: there shall not be male or female barren among you, or among your cattle.
verses.decoded: You will be blessed above all people; there will not be any male or female who is unable to have children among you, or among your livestock.

verses.kjv: And the LORD will take away from thee all sickness, and will put none of the evil diseases of Egypt, which thou knowest, upon thee; but will lay them upon all them that hate thee.
verses.decoded: And the LORD will remove from you all sickness, and will not inflict upon you any of the harmful diseases of Egypt, which you know about; but will place them upon all those who hate you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt consume all the people which the LORD thy God shall deliver thee; thine eye shall have no pity upon them: neither shalt thou serve their gods; for that will be a snare unto thee.
verses.decoded: And you shall consume all the people whom the LORD your God shall deliver to you; your eye shall have no pity on them: nor shall you serve their gods; for that will be a trap for you.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt say in thine heart, These nations are more than I; how can I dispossess them?
verses.decoded: If you say in your heart, 'These nations are more numerous than I am; how can I take possession of their land?'

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid of them: but shalt well remember what the LORD thy God did unto Pharaoh, and unto all Egypt;
verses.decoded: You must not be afraid of them, but you must remember well what the LORD your God did to Pharaoh and to all Egypt.

verses.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the stretched out arm, whereby the LORD thy God brought thee out: so shall the LORD thy God do unto all the people of whom thou art afraid.
verses.decoded: The great trials that your eyes saw, and the signs, and the wonders, and the mighty hand, and the outstretched arm, by which the LORD your God brought you out: so the LORD your God will do to all the people of whom you are afraid.

verses.kjv: Moreover the LORD thy God will send the hornet among them, until they that are left, and hide themselves from thee, be destroyed.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, the Lord your God will send the hornet among them, until those who remain and hide themselves from you are destroyed.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not be affrighted at them: for the LORD thy God is among you, a mighty God and terrible.
verses.decoded: You shall not be afraid of them, because the LORD your God is among you, a mighty and awe-inspiring God.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put out those nations before thee by little and little: thou mayest not consume them at once, lest the beasts of the field increase upon thee.
verses.decoded: And the LORD your God will drive out those nations before you gradually; you must not destroy them all at once, otherwise, the wild animals would multiply against you.

verses.kjv: But the LORD thy God shall deliver them unto thee, and shall destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they be destroyed.
verses.decoded: But the LORD your God will deliver them to you, and will destroy them with a mighty destruction, until they are destroyed.

verses.kjv: And he shall deliver their kings into thine hand, and thou shalt destroy their name from under heaven: there shall no man be able to stand before thee, until thou have destroyed them.
verses.decoded: And he will deliver their kings into your hand, and you will destroy their memory from under heaven: no one will be able to stand before you, until you have destroyed them.

verses.kjv: The graven images of their gods shall ye burn with fire: thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: You must burn their gods' carved images with fire. You must not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it for yourselves, so that you are not trapped by them, because it is detestable to the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou bring an abomination into thine house, lest thou be a cursed thing like it: but thou shalt utterly detest it, and thou shalt utterly abhor it; for it is a cursed thing.
verses.decoded: You must not bring a detestable thing into your house, so that you do not become a cursed thing like it. Instead, you must completely detest it and completely despise it, because it is a cursed thing.

verses.kjv: All the commandments which I command thee this day shall ye observe to do, that ye may live, and multiply, and go in and possess the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers.
verses.decoded: All the commands that I am giving you today you must carefully follow, so that you may live and increase in number, and go in and take possession of the land which the Lord promised to your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt remember all the way which the LORD thy God led thee these forty years in the wilderness, to humble thee, and to prove thee, to know what was in thine heart, whether thou wouldest keep his commandments, or no.
