verses.decoded: And you shall remember all the way which the LORD your God led you these forty years in the wilderness, to humble you, and to test you, to know what was in your heart, whether you would keep his commandments or not.

verses.kjv: And he humbled thee, and suffered thee to hunger, and fed thee with manna, which thou knewest not, neither did thy fathers know; that he might make thee know that man doth not live by bread only, but by every word that proceedeth out of the mouth of the LORD doth man live.
verses.decoded: And he humbled you, and allowed you to hunger, and fed you with manna, which you did not know, nor did your ancestors know; so that he might make you know that humanity does not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of the Lord.

verses.kjv: Thy raiment waxed not old upon thee, neither did thy foot swell, these forty years.
verses.decoded: Your clothing did not wear out on you, nor did your foot swell, these forty years.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt also consider in thine heart, that, as a man chasteneth his son, so the LORD thy God chasteneth thee.
verses.decoded: You should also understand in your heart that, just as a father disciplines his son, so the LORD your God disciplines you.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to fear him.
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to revere him.

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God bringeth thee into a good land, a land of brooks of water, of fountains and depths that spring out of valleys and hills;
verses.decoded: Because the Lord your God is bringing you into a good land, a land with streams of water, with fountains and springs that flow out of valleys and hills.

verses.kjv: A land of wheat, and barley, and vines, and fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of oil olive, and honey;
verses.decoded: A land of wheat, barley, grapevines, fig trees, and pomegranates; a land of olive oil and honey.

verses.kjv: A land wherein thou shalt eat bread without scarceness, thou shalt not lack any thing in it; a land whose stones are iron, and out of whose hills thou mayest dig brass.
verses.decoded: A land where you will eat bread without scarcity, you will not lack anything in it; a land whose stones are iron, and from whose hills you can dig copper.

verses.kjv: When thou hast eaten and art full, then thou shalt bless the LORD thy God for the good land which he hath given thee.
verses.decoded: When you have eaten and are full, then you shall bless the LORD your God for the good land which he has given you.

verses.kjv: Beware that thou forget not the LORD thy God, in not keeping his commandments, and his judgments, and his statutes, which I command thee this day:
verses.decoded: Be careful not to forget the Lord your God by failing to keep his commands, his regulations, and his laws, which I am giving you today:

verses.kjv: Lest when thou hast eaten and art full, and hast built goodly houses, and dwelt therein;
verses.decoded: Be careful that when you have eaten and are satisfied, and have built fine houses and live in them;

verses.kjv: And when thy herds and thy flocks multiply, and thy silver and thy gold is multiplied, and all that thou hast is multiplied;
verses.decoded: And when your herds and your flocks multiply, and your silver and your gold are multiplied, and all that you have is multiplied;

verses.kjv: Then thine heart be lifted up, and thou forget the LORD thy God, which brought thee forth out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage;
verses.decoded: Then your heart will become proud, and you will forget the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the place of slavery;

verses.kjv: Who led thee through that great and terrible wilderness, wherein were fiery serpents, and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought thee forth water out of the rock of flint;
verses.decoded: Who led you through that great and terrifying wilderness, in which there were venomous snakes and scorpions, and drought, where there was no water; who brought you water out of the hard rock;

verses.kjv: Who fed thee in the wilderness with manna, which thy fathers knew not, that he might humble thee, and that he might prove thee, to do thee good at thy latter end;
verses.decoded: He fed you in the wilderness with manna, which your ancestors had not known, so that he might humble you and test you, to do you good in the end.

verses.kjv: And thou say in thine heart, My power and the might of mine hand hath gotten me this wealth.
verses.decoded: And you say in your heart, 'My power and the strength of my hand has obtained this wealth for me.'

verses.kjv: But thou shalt remember the LORD thy God: for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant which he sware unto thy fathers, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: But you shall remember the LORD your God: for it is he who gives you power to acquire wealth, so that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if thou do at all forget the LORD thy God, and walk after other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I testify against you this day that ye shall surely perish.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, if you ever forget the Lord your God, and follow other gods, and serve them, and worship them, I declare against you today that you will certainly be destroyed.

verses.kjv: As the nations which the LORD destroyeth before your face, so shall ye perish; because ye would not be obedient unto the voice of the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: Just as the nations that the LORD destroyed before you, so you will perish because you would not obey the voice of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Hear, O Israel: Thou art to pass over Jordan this day, to go in to possess nations greater and mightier than thyself, cities great and fenced up to heaven,
verses.decoded: Listen, Israel: You are to cross over the Jordan River today, to go in and take possession of nations greater and more powerful than you, cities that are large and fortified up to the sky,

verses.kjv: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom thou knowest, and of whom thou hast heard say, Who can stand before the children of Anak!
verses.decoded: A people great and tall, the children of the Anakims, whom you know, and of whom you have heard it said, Who can stand before the children of Anak!

verses.kjv: Understand therefore this day, that the LORD thy God is he which goeth over before thee; as a consuming fire he shall destroy them, and he shall bring them down before thy face: so shalt thou drive them out, and destroy them quickly, as the LORD hath said unto thee.
verses.decoded: Therefore, understand today, that the LORD your God is the one who goes before you; like a consuming fire, he will destroy them, and he will bring them down before you: so you will drive them out and destroy them quickly, as the LORD has said to you.

verses.kjv: Speak not thou in thine heart, after that the LORD thy God hath cast them out from before thee, saying, For my righteousness the LORD hath brought me in to possess this land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD doth drive them out from before thee.
verses.decoded: Do not say in your heart, after the LORD your God has driven them out from before you, 'It is because of my righteousness that the LORD has brought me in to possess this land,' but rather, 'It is because of the wickedness of these nations that the LORD is driving them out from before you.'

verses.kjv: Not for thy righteousness, or for the uprightness of thine heart, dost thou go to possess their land: but for the wickedness of these nations the LORD thy God doth drive them out from before thee, and that he may perform the word which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.
verses.decoded: Not because of your righteousness, or because of the integrity of your heart, are you going to take possession of their land; but because of the wickedness of these nations the Lord your God is driving them out from before you, and so that he may fulfill the promise which the Lord swore to your ancestors, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.

verses.kjv: Understand therefore, that the LORD thy God giveth thee not this good land to possess it for thy righteousness; for thou art a stiffnecked people.
verses.decoded: Therefore understand that the LORD your God is not giving you this good land to possess because of your righteousness; for you are a stubborn people.

verses.kjv: Remember, and forget not, how thou provokedst the LORD thy God to wrath in the wilderness: from the day that thou didst depart out of the land of Egypt, until ye came unto this place, ye have been rebellious against the LORD.
verses.decoded: Remember, and do not forget, how you provoked the LORD your God to anger in the wilderness: from the day that you departed from the land of Egypt, until you came to this place.

verses.kjv: Also in Horeb ye provoked the LORD to wrath, so that the LORD was angry with you to have destroyed you.
verses.decoded: Also at Horeb you angered the Lord, so that the Lord was furious with you and intended to destroy you.

verses.kjv: When I was gone up into the mount to receive the tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I abode in the mount forty days and forty nights, I neither did eat bread nor drink water:
verses.decoded: When I went up into the mountain to receive the stone tablets, specifically the tablets of the covenant which the LORD made with you, then I remained on the mountain for forty days and forty nights, I neither ate bread nor drank water.

verses.kjv: And the LORD delivered unto me two tables of stone written with the finger of God; and on them was written according to all the words, which the LORD spake with you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly.
verses.decoded: And the LORD gave to me two tablets of stone written by the finger of God; and on them was written all the words which the LORD spoke with you on the mountain out of the middle of the fire on the day of the assembly.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass at the end of forty days and forty nights, that the LORD gave me the two tables of stone, even the tables of the covenant.
verses.decoded: And it happened at the end of forty days and forty nights that the Lord gave me the two stone tablets, which were the tablets of the covenant.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, get thee down quickly from hence; for thy people which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt have corrupted themselves; they are quickly turned aside out of the way which I commanded them; they have made them a molten image.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to me, 'Get up, go down quickly from here, because your people whom you brought out of Egypt have corrupted themselves;'

verses.kjv: Furthermore the LORD spake unto me, saying, I have seen this people, and, behold, it is a stiffnecked people:
verses.decoded: Additionally, the LORD spoke to me, saying, I have seen this people, and indeed, they are a stubborn people.

verses.kjv: Let me alone, that I may destroy them, and blot out their name from under heaven: and I will make of thee a nation mightier and greater than they.
verses.decoded: Leave me alone, so that I may destroy them, and erase their name from under heaven: and I will make you into a nation mightier and greater than them.

verses.kjv: So I turned and came down from the mount, and the mount burned with fire: and the two tables of the covenant were in my two hands.
verses.decoded: So I turned and came down from the mountain, and the mountain was burning with fire: and the two tablets of the covenant were in my two hands.

verses.kjv: And I looked, and, behold, ye had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made you a molten calf: ye had turned aside quickly out of the way which the LORD had commanded you.
verses.decoded: And I looked, and saw that you had sinned against the LORD your God, and had made yourselves a molten calf: you had quickly turned aside from the way which the LORD had commanded you.

verses.kjv: And I took the two tables, and cast them out of my two hands, and brake them before your eyes.
verses.decoded: And I took the two tablets, and threw them out of my two hands, and broke them before your eyes.

verses.kjv: And I fell down before the LORD, as at the first, forty days and forty nights: I did neither eat bread, nor drink water, because of all your sins which ye sinned, in doing wickedly in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger.
verses.decoded: And I fell down before the Lord, just as I did the first time, for forty days and forty nights. I did not eat bread or drink water, because of all your sins that you committed, by doing evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger.

verses.kjv: For I was afraid of the anger and hot displeasure, wherewith the LORD was wroth against you to destroy you. But the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also.
verses.decoded: Because I was afraid of the anger and intense displeasure, with which the LORD was angry with you, intending to destroy you. But the LORD listened to me at that time as well.

verses.kjv: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron to have destroyed him: and I prayed for Aaron also the same time.
verses.decoded: And the LORD was very angry with Aaron, intending to destroy him, and I also prayed for Aaron at that same time.

verses.kjv: And I took your sin, the calf which ye had made, and burnt it with fire, and stamped it, and ground it very small, even until it was as small as dust: and I cast the dust thereof into the brook that descended out of the mount.
verses.decoded: And I took the calf that was your sin, which you had made, and burned it with fire, and crushed it, and ground it into very small pieces, until it was as fine as dust; and I threw its dust into the stream that flowed down from the mountain.

verses.kjv: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, ye provoked the LORD to wrath.
verses.decoded: And at Taberah, and at Massah, and at Kibrothhattaavah, you angered the Lord.

verses.kjv: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and possess the land which I have given you; then ye rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God, and ye believed him not, nor hearkened to his voice.
verses.decoded: Likewise when the LORD sent you from Kadeshbarnea, saying, Go up and take possession of the land that I have given you; then you rebelled against the command of the LORD your God, and you did not believe him, nor did you listen to his voice.

verses.kjv: Ye have been rebellious against the LORD from the day that I knew you.
verses.decoded: You have been rebellious against the LORD, from the day that I knew you.

verses.kjv: Thus I fell down before the LORD forty days and forty nights, as I fell down at the first; because the LORD had said he would destroy you.
verses.decoded: So I prostrated myself before the Lord for forty days and forty nights, just as I had done previously, because the Lord had said he would destroy you.

verses.kjv: I prayed therefore unto the LORD, and said, O Lord GOD, destroy not thy people and thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed through thy greatness, which thou hast brought forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand.
verses.decoded: Therefore I prayed to the LORD and said, O Lord GOD, do not destroy your people and your inheritance, which you have redeemed through your greatness.

verses.kjv: Remember thy servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; look not unto the stubbornness of this people, nor to their wickedness, nor to their sin:
verses.decoded: Remember your servants, Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob; do not consider the stubbornness of these people, nor their wickedness, nor their sin.

verses.kjv: Lest the land whence thou broughtest us out say, Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land which he promised them, and because he hated them, he hath brought them out to slay them in the wilderness.
verses.decoded: Otherwise, the land from which you brought us out might say, 'Because the LORD was not able to bring them into the land that he promised them, and because he hated them, he has brought them out to kill them in the wilderness.'

verses.kjv: Yet they are thy people and thine inheritance, which thou broughtest out by thy mighty power and by thy stretched out arm.
verses.decoded: Yet they are your people and your inheritance, which you brought out by your mighty power and by your stretched out arm.

verses.kjv: At that time the LORD said unto me, Hew thee two tables of stone like unto the first, and come up unto me into the mount, and make thee an ark of wood.
verses.decoded: At that time the LORD said to me, 'Carve for yourself two stone tablets like the first ones, and come up to me onto the mountain, and make for yourself an ark of wood.'

verses.kjv: And I will write on the tables the words that were in the first tables which thou brakest, and thou shalt put them in the ark.
verses.decoded: And I will write on the tablets the words that were on the first tablets which you broke, and you shall put them in the ark.

verses.kjv: And I made an ark of shittim wood, and hewed two tables of stone like unto the first, and went up into the mount, having the two tables in mine hand.
verses.decoded: And I made an ark from acacia wood, and carved two stone tablets like the first ones, and went up the mountain, holding the two tablets in my hand.

verses.kjv: And he wrote on the tables, according to the first writing, the ten commandments, which the LORD spake unto you in the mount out of the midst of the fire in the day of the assembly: and the LORD gave them unto me.
verses.decoded: And he wrote on the tablets, just as he had written before, the ten commandments, which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the middle of the fire.

verses.kjv: And I turned myself and came down from the mount, and put the tables in the ark which I had made; and there they be, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.decoded: And I turned and came down from the mountain, and put the tablets in the ark that I had made; and they are there, as the LORD commanded me.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel took their journey from Beeroth of the children of Jaakan to Mosera: there Aaron died, and there he was buried; and Eleazar his son ministered in the priest’s office in his stead.
verses.decoded: The Israelites traveled from Beeroth of the Jaakanites to Mosera: Aaron died there and was buried there; and his son Eleazar served as priest in his place.

verses.kjv: From thence they journeyed unto Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land of rivers of waters.
verses.decoded: From there they traveled to Gudgodah; and from Gudgodah to Jotbath, a land with rivers of water.

verses.kjv: At that time the LORD separated the tribe of Levi, to bear the ark of the covenant of the LORD, to stand before the LORD to minister unto him, and to bless in his name, unto this day.
verses.decoded: At that time, the Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord, to stand before the Lord to serve him, and to give blessings in his name, until this day.

verses.kjv: Wherefore Levi hath no part nor inheritance with his brethren; the LORD is his inheritance, according as the LORD thy God promised him.
verses.decoded: Therefore, Levi has no portion or inheritance with his relatives; the LORD is his inheritance, just as the LORD your God promised him.

verses.kjv: And I stayed in the mount, according to the first time, forty days and forty nights; and the LORD hearkened unto me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy thee.
verses.decoded: And I remained on the mountain, just as I did the first time, for forty days and forty nights; and the LORD listened to me at that time also, and the LORD would not destroy you.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto me, Arise, take thy journey before the people, that they may go in and possess the land, which I sware unto their fathers to give unto them.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to me, Arise, take your journey before the people, so that they may go in and possess the land, which I swore to their fathers to give to them.

verses.kjv: And now, Israel, what doth the LORD thy God require of thee, but to fear the LORD thy God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD thy God with all thy heart and with all thy soul,
verses.decoded: And now, Israel, what does the LORD your God require of you, but to fear the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to love him, and to serve the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.kjv: To keep the commandments of the LORD, and his statutes, which I command thee this day for thy good?
verses.decoded: To obey the commands of the Lord, and his laws, which I am giving you today for your benefit?

verses.kjv: Behold, the heaven and the heaven of heavens is the LORD’s thy God, the earth also, with all that therein is.
verses.decoded: Indeed, the heavens, even the highest heavens, belong to the LORD your God, the earth also, and everything in it.

verses.kjv: Only the LORD had a delight in thy fathers to love them, and he chose their seed after them, even you above all people, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: Only the LORD took pleasure in your ancestors to love them, and he chose their descendants after them, even you above all people, as it is today.

verses.kjv: Circumcise therefore the foreskin of your heart, and be no more stiffnecked.
verses.decoded: Therefore, purify your inner self, and stop being obstinate.

verses.kjv: For the LORD your God is God of gods, and Lord of lords, a great God, a mighty, and a terrible, which regardeth not persons, nor taketh reward:
verses.decoded: For the Lord your God is the God of gods and the Lord of lords, a great God, mighty and awesome, who does not show partiality nor accept bribes.

verses.kjv: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
verses.decoded: He executes justice for the fatherless and the widow, and loves the foreigner, by giving him food and clothing.

verses.kjv: Love ye therefore the stranger: for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt.
verses.decoded: Therefore, you must love the foreigner, because you were foreigners in the land of Egypt.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt fear the LORD thy God; him shalt thou serve, and to him shalt thou cleave, and swear by his name.
verses.decoded: You shall fear the LORD your God; you shall serve him, and you shall remain loyal to him, and swear by his name.

verses.kjv: He is thy praise, and he is thy God, that hath done for thee these great and terrible things, which thine eyes have seen.
verses.decoded: He is your praise, and he is your God, who has done for you these great and awesome things, which your eyes have seen.

verses.kjv: Thy fathers went down into Egypt with threescore and ten persons; and now the LORD thy God hath made thee as the stars of heaven for multitude.
verses.decoded: Your ancestors went down into Egypt with seventy people; and now the LORD your God has made you as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou shalt love the LORD thy God, and keep his charge, and his statutes, and his judgments, and his commandments, alway.
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall love the LORD your God, and keep his instruction, and his laws, and his ordinances, and his commandments, always.

verses.kjv: And know ye this day: for I speak not with your children which have not known, and which have not seen the chastisement of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his stretched out arm,
verses.decoded: And understand this day: for I am not speaking with your children who have not known, and who have not seen the discipline of the LORD your God, his greatness, his mighty hand, and his outstretched arm,

verses.kjv: And his miracles, and his acts, which he did in the midst of Egypt unto Pharaoh the king of Egypt, and unto all his land;
verses.decoded: And his miracles, and his actions, which he performed in Egypt for Pharaoh, the king of Egypt, and for all his land;

verses.kjv: And what he did unto the army of Egypt, unto their horses, and to their chariots; how he made the water of the Red sea to overflow them as they pursued after you, and how the LORD hath destroyed them unto this day;
verses.decoded: And what he did to the army of Egypt, to their horses, and to their chariots; how he caused the water of the Red Sea to overwhelm them as they pursued them, and how the LORD destroyed them to this day.

verses.kjv: And what he did unto you in the wilderness, until ye came into this place;
verses.decoded: And what he did to you in the wilderness, until you came into this place.

verses.kjv: And what he did unto Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their households, and their tents, and all the substance that was in their possession, in the midst of all Israel:
verses.decoded: And what he did to Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, the son of Reuben: how the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them, along with their households, their tents, and all the possessions they had, in the presence of all Israel.

verses.kjv: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the LORD which he did.
verses.decoded: But your eyes have seen all the great acts of the Lord which he did.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye keep all the commandments which I command you this day, that ye may be strong, and go in and possess the land, whither ye go to possess it;
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall keep all the commandments which I command you today, that you may be strong, and go in to possess the land, where you go to possess it;

verses.kjv: And that ye may prolong your days in the land, which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give unto them and to their seed, a land that floweth with milk and honey.
verses.decoded: So that you may live long in the land, which the Lord promised to your ancestors to give to them and to their descendants, a land that is abundant with milk and honey.

verses.kjv: For the land, whither thou goest in to possess it, is not as the land of Egypt, from whence ye came out, where thou sowedst thy seed, and wateredst it with thy foot, as a garden of herbs:
verses.decoded: For the land, which you are entering to take possession of, is not like the land of Egypt, from where you came out, where you planted your seed and watered it with your foot, like a garden of herbs:

verses.kjv: But the land, whither ye go to possess it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinketh water of the rain of heaven:
verses.decoded: But the land, where you go to take possession of it, is a land of hills and valleys, and drinks water from the rain of heaven:

verses.kjv: A land which the LORD thy God careth for: the eyes of the LORD thy God are always upon it, from the beginning of the year even unto the end of the year.
verses.decoded: A land which the LORD your God cares for: the eyes of the LORD your God are always on it, from the beginning of the year until the end of the year.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, if ye shall hearken diligently unto my commandments which I command you this day, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,
verses.decoded: And it will happen, if you carefully listen to my commands which I am giving you today, to love the LORD your God, and to serve him with all your heart and with all your soul,

verses.kjv: That I will give you the rain of your land in his due season, the first rain and the latter rain, that thou mayest gather in thy corn, and thy wine, and thine oil.
verses.decoded: Then I will give you the rain for your land in its proper season, the early rain and the late rain, so that you may gather in your grain, your wine, and your oil.

verses.kjv: And I will send grass in thy fields for thy cattle, that thou mayest eat and be full.
verses.decoded: And I will send grass in your fields for your cattle, so that you may eat and be full.

verses.kjv: Take heed to yourselves, that your heart be not deceived, and ye turn aside, and serve other gods, and worship them;
verses.decoded: Be careful not to let your hearts be deceived, so that you do not turn away to serve other gods and worship them.

verses.kjv: And then the LORD’s wrath be kindled against you, and he shut up the heaven, that there be no rain, and that the land yield not her fruit; and lest ye perish quickly from off the good land which the LORD giveth you.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord's anger will be ignited against you, and he will close up the sky so that there will be no rain, and the land will not produce its crops; and you will quickly die off the good land that the Lord is giving you.

verses.kjv: Therefore shall ye lay up these my words in your heart and in your soul, and bind them for a sign upon your hand, that they may be as frontlets between your eyes.
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall store these my words in your heart and in your soul; and you shall tie them as a symbol on your hand, and they shall be as headbands between your eyes.

verses.kjv: And ye shall teach them your children, speaking of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.
verses.decoded: And you shall teach them to your children, speaking of them when you sit in your house, and when you walk by the way, when you lie down, and when you rise up.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt write them upon the door posts of thine house, and upon thy gates:
verses.decoded: And you shall write them upon the doorposts of your house, and upon your gates:

verses.kjv: That your days may be multiplied, and the days of your children, in the land which the LORD sware unto your fathers to give them, as the days of heaven upon the earth.
verses.decoded: So that your days and the days of your children may be many in the land which the LORD promised to your ancestors to give them, as long as the heavens are above the earth.

verses.kjv: For if ye shall diligently keep all these commandments which I command you, to do them, to love the LORD your God, to walk in all his ways, and to cleave unto him;
verses.decoded: For if you will carefully keep all these commands that I am giving you, to obey them, to love the Lord your God, to walk in all his ways, and to remain loyal to him;

verses.kjv: Then will the LORD drive out all these nations from before you, and ye shall possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.
verses.decoded: Then the LORD will drive out all these nations from before you, and you will possess greater nations and mightier than yourselves.

verses.kjv: Every place whereon the soles of your feet shall tread shall be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the river Euphrates, even unto the uttermost sea shall your coast be.
verses.decoded: Every place where the soles of your feet step will be yours: from the wilderness and Lebanon, from the river, the Euphrates River, even to the farthest sea will be your territory.

verses.kjv: There shall no man be able to stand before you: for the LORD your God shall lay the fear of you and the dread of you upon all the land that ye shall tread upon, as he hath said unto you.
verses.decoded: No one will be able to stand against you, because the LORD your God will put the fear and dread of you upon all the land that you will walk on, just as he has told you.

verses.kjv: Behold, I set before you this day a blessing and a curse;
verses.decoded: Look, I am presenting to you today a blessing and a curse;

verses.kjv: A blessing, if ye obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you this day:
verses.decoded: A blessing, if you obey the commandments of the LORD your God, which I command you today:

verses.kjv: And a curse, if ye will not obey the commandments of the LORD your God, but turn aside out of the way which I command you this day, to go after other gods, which ye have not known.
verses.decoded: And a curse, if you will not obey the commands of the Lord your God, but turn away from the path that I am commanding you today, to follow other gods, which you have not known.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when the LORD thy God hath brought thee in unto the land whither thou goest to possess it, that thou shalt put the blessing upon mount Gerizim, and the curse upon mount Ebal.
verses.decoded: It will happen that when the Lord your God has brought you into the land where you are going to take possession of it, you will pronounce the blessing on

verses.kjv: Are they not on the other side Jordan, by the way where the sun goeth down, in the land of the Canaanites, which dwell in the champaign over against Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?
verses.decoded: Are they not on the other side of the Jordan, to the west, in the land of the Canaanites, who live in the open country opposite Gilgal, beside the plains of Moreh?

verses.kjv: For ye shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God giveth you, and ye shall possess it, and dwell therein.
verses.decoded: For you shall pass over Jordan to go in to possess the land which the LORD your God gives you, and you shall possess it, and dwell in it.

verses.kjv: And ye shall observe to do all the statutes and judgments which I set before you this day.
verses.decoded: And you must be careful to do all the laws and rules that I am giving you today.

verses.kjv: These are the statutes and judgments, which ye shall observe to do in the land, which the LORD God of thy fathers giveth thee to possess it, all the days that ye live upon the earth.
verses.decoded: These are the laws and rules which you must observe and follow in the land which the LORD God of your ancestors gives you to possess, all the days that you live on the earth.

verses.kjv: Ye shall utterly destroy all the places, wherein the nations which ye shall possess served their gods, upon the high mountains, and upon the hills, and under every green tree:
verses.decoded: You must completely destroy all the places where the nations you will dispossess served their gods, on the high mountains, and on the hills, and under every green tree.

verses.kjv: And ye shall overthrow their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and ye shall hew down the graven images of their gods, and destroy the names of them out of that place.
verses.decoded: And you shall demolish their altars, and break their pillars, and burn their groves with fire; and you shall cut down the carved images of their gods.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not do so unto the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You must not do this to the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: But unto the place which the LORD your God shall choose out of all your tribes to put his name there, even unto his habitation shall ye seek, and thither thou shalt come:
verses.decoded: But to the place which the LORD your God will choose from all your tribes to place his name there, even to his dwelling place you shall seek, and there you shall come.

verses.kjv: And thither ye shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and heave offerings of your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstlings of your herds and of your flocks:
verses.decoded: And there you shall bring your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, and your tithes, and contributions from your hand, and your vows, and your freewill offerings, and the firstborn of your herds and of your flocks:

verses.kjv: And there ye shall eat before the LORD your God, and ye shall rejoice in all that ye put your hand unto, ye and your households, wherein the LORD thy God hath blessed thee.
verses.decoded: And there you shall eat before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice in all that you undertake, you and your households, in which the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not do after all the things that we do here this day, every man whatsoever is right in his own eyes.
verses.decoded: You must not do all the things that we do here today, with each person doing whatever they consider right.

verses.kjv: For ye are not as yet come to the rest and to the inheritance, which the LORD your God giveth you.
verses.decoded: For you have not yet come to the resting place and to the inheritance, which the Lord your God gives you.

verses.kjv: But when ye go over Jordan, and dwell in the land which the LORD your God giveth you to inherit, and when he giveth you rest from all your enemies round about, so that ye dwell in safety;
verses.decoded: But when you go over Jordan and dwell in the land which the LORD your God gives you to inherit, and when he gives you rest from all your enemies all around, so that you dwell in safety.

verses.kjv: Then there shall be a place which the LORD your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there; thither shall ye bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the heave offering of your hand, and all your choice vows which ye vow unto the LORD:
verses.decoded: Then there will be a place which the LORD your God will choose to make his name reside there; there you shall bring all that I command you; your burnt offerings, and your sacrifices, your tithes, and the special contribution from your hand, and all your chosen vows which you make to the LORD:

verses.kjv: And ye shall rejoice before the LORD your God, ye, and your sons, and your daughters, and your menservants, and your maidservants, and the Levite that is within your gates; forasmuch as he hath no part nor inheritance with you.
verses.decoded: And you shall rejoice before the Lord your God, you, and your sons, and your daughters, and your male servants, and your female servants, and the Levite who is within your gates, because he has no portion or inheritance with you.

verses.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou offer not thy burnt offerings in every place that thou seest:
verses.decoded: Be careful that you do not offer your burnt offerings in every place that you see.

verses.kjv: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of thy tribes, there thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, and there thou shalt do all that I command thee.
verses.decoded: But in the place which the LORD shall choose in one of your tribes, there you must offer your burnt offerings, and there you must do all that I command you.

verses.kjv: Notwithstanding thou mayest kill and eat flesh in all thy gates, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee: the unclean and the clean may eat thereof, as of the roebuck, and as of the hart.
verses.decoded: However, you may kill and eat meat in all your towns, whatever your heart desires, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which he has given you: the ritually unclean and the ritually clean may eat of it, as they would eat a gazelle or a deer.

verses.kjv: Only ye shall not eat the blood; ye shall pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.decoded: However, you must not eat the blood; you must pour it on the ground like water.

verses.kjv: Thou mayest not eat within thy gates the tithe of thy corn, or of thy wine, or of thy oil, or the firstlings of thy herds or of thy flock, nor any of thy vows which thou vowest, nor thy freewill offerings, or heave offering of thine hand:
verses.decoded: You may not eat within your towns the tithe of your grain, or of your wine, or of your oil, or the firstborn of your cattle or of your flock, nor any of your vowed offerings.

verses.kjv: But thou must eat them before the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates: and thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God in all that thou puttest thine hands unto.
verses.decoded: But you must eat them before the LORD your God in the place which the LORD your God will choose, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male servant, and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your towns: and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God in all that you put your hands to.

verses.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou forsake not the Levite as long as thou livest upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Be careful not to neglect the Levite as long as you live on the earth.

verses.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall enlarge thy border, as he hath promised thee, and thou shalt say, I will eat flesh, because thy soul longeth to eat flesh; thou mayest eat flesh, whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.decoded: When the LORD your God enlarges your territory, as he has promised you, and you say, 'I will eat meat,' because you desire to eat meat;

verses.kjv: If the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to put his name there be too far from thee, then thou shalt kill of thy herd and of thy flock, which the LORD hath given thee, as I have commanded thee, and thou shalt eat in thy gates whatsoever thy soul lusteth after.
verses.decoded: If the place which the LORD your God has chosen to establish his presence there is too far for you, then you shall slaughter from your cattle and from your flock, which the LORD has given you, and you shall eat within your towns whatever your heart desires.

verses.kjv: Even as the roebuck and the hart is eaten, so thou shalt eat them: the unclean and the clean shall eat of them alike.
verses.decoded: Just as the deer and the stag are eaten, so you may eat them: both the ritually unclean and the ritually clean may eat of it equally.

verses.kjv: Only be sure that thou eat not the blood: for the blood is the life; and thou mayest not eat the life with the flesh.
verses.decoded: Only be sure that you do not eat the blood, because the blood is the life, and you must not eat the life with the flesh.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water.
verses.decoded: You must not eat it; you must pour it on the ground like water.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not eat it; that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee, when thou shalt do that which is right in the sight of the LORD.
verses.decoded: You must not eat it, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you, when you do what is right in the sight of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Only thy holy things which thou hast, and thy vows, thou shalt take, and go unto the place which the LORD shall choose:
verses.decoded: Only your holy things which you have, and your vows, you shall take, and go to the place which the Lord chooses.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt offer thy burnt offerings, the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD thy God: and the blood of thy sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD thy God, and thou shalt eat the flesh.
verses.decoded: You shall offer your burnt offerings, consisting of the flesh and the blood, upon the altar of the LORD your God. The blood of your sacrifices shall be poured out upon the altar of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Observe and hear all these words which I command thee, that it may go well with thee, and with thy children after thee for ever, when thou doest that which is good and right in the sight of the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: Observe and listen to all these words that I command you, so that it may go well with you and with your children after you forever, when you do what is good and right in the sight of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: When the LORD thy God shall cut off the nations from before thee, whither thou goest to possess them, and thou succeedest them, and dwellest in their land;
verses.decoded: When the LORD your God cuts off the nations from before you, where you go to take possession of them, and you succeed them, and live in their land;

verses.kjv: Take heed to thyself that thou be not snared by following them, after that they be destroyed from before thee; and that thou enquire not after their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? even so will I do likewise.
verses.decoded: Be careful that you are not trapped by following them, after they have been destroyed from before you; and that you do not inquire about their gods, saying, How did these nations serve their gods? I will do the same.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not do so unto the LORD thy God: for every abomination to the LORD, which he hateth, have they done unto their gods; for even their sons and their daughters they have burnt in the fire to their gods.
verses.decoded: You must not do this to the LORD your God, because they have done to their gods every detestable act that the LORD hates; for they have even burned their sons and their daughters in the fire as sacrifices to their gods.

verses.kjv: What thing soever I command you, observe to do it: thou shalt not add thereto, nor diminish from it.
verses.decoded: Whatever I command you, be careful to do it; you must not add to it or take away from it.

verses.kjv: If there arise among you a prophet, or a dreamer of dreams, and giveth thee a sign or a wonder,
verses.decoded: If a prophet or a dreamer of dreams arises among you and gives you a sign or a wonder,

verses.kjv: And the sign or the wonder come to pass, whereof he spake unto thee, saying, Let us go after other gods, which thou hast not known, and let us serve them;
verses.decoded: And if the sign or the wonder that he spoke to you about comes to pass, saying, 'Let us go after other gods, which you have not known, and let us serve them;'

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not hearken unto the words of that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams: for the LORD your God proveth you, to know whether ye love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
verses.decoded: You must not listen to the words of that prophet or that dreamer of dreams, because the Lord your God is testing you, to know if you love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.kjv: Ye shall walk after the LORD your God, and fear him, and keep his commandments, and obey his voice, and ye shall serve him, and cleave unto him.
verses.decoded: You shall follow the Lord your God, and revere him, and keep his commands, and obey his voice, and you shall serve him, and cling to him.

verses.kjv: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, shall be put to death; because he hath spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, and redeemed you out of the house of bondage, to thrust thee out of the way which the LORD thy God commanded thee to walk in. So shalt thou put the evil away from the midst of thee.
verses.decoded: And that prophet, or that dreamer of dreams, will be put to death; because he has spoken to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to drive you out of the way which the LORD your God commanded you to walk in. So you will remove the evil from among you.

verses.kjv: If thy brother, the son of thy mother, or thy son, or thy daughter, or the wife of thy bosom, or thy friend, which is as thine own soul, entice thee secretly, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which thou hast not known, thou, nor thy fathers;
verses.decoded: If your brother, your mother's son, or your son, or your daughter, or the wife you cherish, or your friend, who is as dear as your own life, tempts you.

verses.kjv: Namely, of the gods of the people which are round about you, nigh unto thee, or far off from thee, from the one end of the earth even unto the other end of the earth;
verses.decoded: Specifically, concerning the gods of the people who are around you, near to you, or far away from you, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth;

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not consent unto him, nor hearken unto him; neither shall thine eye pity him, neither shalt thou spare, neither shalt thou conceal him:
verses.decoded: You must not agree with him, nor listen to him; nor should you feel sorry for him, nor should you spare him, nor should you hide him.

verses.kjv: But thou shalt surely kill him; thine hand shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterwards the hand of all the people.
verses.decoded: But you shall surely kill him; your hand shall be the first against him to put him to death, and afterward the hand of all the people.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt stone him with stones, that he die; because he hath sought to thrust thee away from the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt, from the house of bondage.
verses.decoded: But you shall stone him with stones, so that he dies, because he has tried to turn you away from the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, from the place of slavery.

verses.kjv: And all Israel shall hear, and fear, and shall do no more any such wickedness as this is among you.
verses.decoded: And all Israel will hear, and be afraid, and will no longer do any such evil as this among you.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt hear say in one of thy cities, which the LORD thy God hath given thee to dwell there, saying,
verses.decoded: If you hear it said in one of your cities, which the LORD your God has given you to live in, saying,

verses.kjv: Certain men, the children of Belial, are gone out from among you, and have withdrawn the inhabitants of their city, saying, Let us go and serve other gods, which ye have not known;
verses.decoded: Some men, wicked individuals, have gone out from among you, and have led astray the inhabitants of their city, saying, 'Let us go and serve other gods, which you have not known;'

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou enquire, and make search, and ask diligently; and, behold, if it be truth, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought among you;
verses.decoded: Then you must inquire, and make a search, and ask diligently; and, look, if it is true, and the matter is certain, that such a detestable act has been done among you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt surely smite the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it utterly, and all that is therein, and the cattle thereof, with the edge of the sword.
verses.decoded: You shall surely strike the inhabitants of that city with the edge of the sword, destroying it completely, and everything that is in it, and its cattle, with the edge of the sword.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt gather all the spoil of it into the midst of the street thereof, and shalt burn with fire the city, and all the spoil thereof every whit, for the LORD thy God: and it shall be an heap for ever; it shall not be built again.
verses.decoded: And you shall gather all the plunder from it into the middle of its street, and shall burn the city with fire, and all its plunder completely, and it shall be a heap forever; and it shall not be rebuilt.

verses.kjv: And there shall cleave nought of the cursed thing to thine hand: that the LORD may turn from the fierceness of his anger, and shew thee mercy, and have compassion upon thee, and multiply thee, as he hath sworn unto thy fathers;
verses.decoded: And nothing of the cursed thing shall remain in your hand, so that the Lord may turn from the intensity of his anger, and show you mercy, and have compassion on you, and multiply you, as he has sworn to your fathers;

verses.kjv: When thou shalt hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep all his commandments which I command thee this day, to do that which is right in the eyes of the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: When you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to obey all his commands which I give you today, to do what is right in the sight of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Ye are the children of the LORD your God: ye shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.
verses.decoded: You are the children of the LORD your God: you must not cut yourselves, nor make yourselves bald on your foreheads for the dead.

verses.kjv: For thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God, and the LORD hath chosen thee to be a peculiar people unto himself, above all the nations that are upon the earth.
verses.decoded: For you are a holy people to the LORD your God, and the LORD has chosen you to be a special people for himself, above all the nations that are on the earth.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not eat any abominable thing.
verses.decoded: You must not eat any detestable thing.

verses.kjv: These are the beasts which ye shall eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat,
verses.decoded: These are the animals that you may eat: the ox, the sheep, and the goat.

verses.kjv: The hart, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.
verses.decoded: The stag, and the roebuck, and the fallow deer, and the wild goat, and the pygarg, and the wild ox, and the chamois.

verses.kjv: And every beast that parteth the hoof, and cleaveth the cleft into two claws, and cheweth the cud among the beasts, that ye shall eat.
verses.decoded: And every animal that has divided hooves, and has hooves split into two parts, and chews the cud among the animals, you may eat.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless these ye shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the cloven hoof; as the camel, and the hare, and the coney: for they chew the cud, but divide not the hoof; therefore they are unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: However, you must not eat these animals that chew the cud or have divided hooves: the camel, the hare, and the rock badger. Although they chew the cud, they do not have divided hooves; therefore, they are unclean for you.

verses.kjv: And the swine, because it divideth the hoof, yet cheweth not the cud, it is unclean unto you: ye shall not eat of their flesh, nor touch their dead carcase.
verses.decoded: And the pig, because it has divided hooves yet does not chew the cud, it is unclean for you: you shall not eat its meat, nor touch its dead body.

verses.kjv: These ye shall eat of all that are in the waters: all that have fins and scales shall ye eat:
verses.decoded: You shall eat these from all that are in the waters: you shall eat all that have fins and scales.

verses.kjv: And whatsoever hath not fins and scales ye may not eat; it is unclean unto you.
verses.decoded: And anything that does not have fins and scales you may not eat; it is unclean for you.

verses.kjv: Of all clean birds ye shall eat.
verses.decoded: You may eat all clean birds.

verses.kjv: But these are they of which ye shall not eat: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.decoded: But these are the ones you must not eat: the eagle, the ossifrage, and the ospray.

verses.kjv: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture after his kind,
verses.decoded: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture of its kind,

verses.kjv: And every raven after his kind,
verses.decoded: And every raven according to its kind.

verses.kjv: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.decoded: This includes the owl, the night hawk, the cuckoo, and the hawk, each according to its species.

verses.kjv: The little owl, and the great owl, and the swan,
verses.decoded: the little owl, and the great owl, and the cormorant,

verses.kjv: And the pelican, and the gier eagle, and the cormorant,
verses.decoded: And the glede, and the kite, and the vulture, and the raven according to its species,

verses.kjv: And the stork, and the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.decoded: And the stork, and the heron of its kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.

verses.kjv: And every creeping thing that flieth is unclean unto you: they shall not be eaten.
verses.decoded: And every creeping thing that flies is unclean for you: you must not eat them.

verses.kjv: But of all clean fowls ye may eat.
verses.decoded: You shall eat every clean bird.

verses.kjv: Ye shall not eat of anything that dieth of itself: thou shalt give it unto the stranger that is in thy gates, that he may eat it; or thou mayest sell it unto an alien: for thou art an holy people unto the LORD thy God. Thou shalt not seethe a kid in his mother’s milk.
verses.decoded: You must not eat anything that dies on its own: you must give it to the foreigner who is within your gates, so that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a non-Israelite: because you are a holy people to the LORD your God. You must not cook a young goat in its mother's milk.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt truly tithe all the increase of thy seed, that the field bringeth forth year by year.
verses.decoded: You shall truly set aside a tenth of all the produce of your crops that the field yields year by year.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat before the LORD thy God, in the place which he shall choose to place his name there, the tithe of thy corn, of thy wine, and of thine oil, and the firstlings of thy herds and of thy flocks; that thou mayest learn to fear the LORD thy God always.
verses.decoded: And you shall eat before the LORD your God, in the place which he shall choose to establish his presence there, the tenth of your grain, of your wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your cattle and of your flock; so that you may learn to revere the LORD your God always.

verses.kjv: And if the way be too long for thee, so that thou art not able to carry it; or if the place be too far from thee, which the LORD thy God shall choose to set his name there, when the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.decoded: And if the journey is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it; or if the place is too far from you, which the LORD your God will choose.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou turn it into money, and bind up the money in thine hand, and shalt go unto the place which the LORD thy God shall choose:
verses.decoded: Then you shall convert it into money, and secure the money in your hand, and you shall go to the place which the Lord your God will choose.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt bestow that money for whatsoever thy soul lusteth after, for oxen, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatsoever thy soul desireth: and thou shalt eat there before the LORD thy God, and thou shalt rejoice, thou, and thine household,
verses.decoded: And you shall spend that money for whatever your heart desires, for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your heart desires; and you shall eat there before the LORD your God, and you shall rejoice, you, and your household,

verses.kjv: And the Levite that is within thy gates; thou shalt not forsake him; for he hath no part nor inheritance with thee.
verses.decoded: And the Levite who is within your gates; you shall not abandon him; for he has no portion or inheritance with you.

verses.kjv: At the end of three years thou shalt bring forth all the tithe of thine increase the same year, and shalt lay it up within thy gates:
verses.decoded: At the end of three years, you shall bring forth all the tithe of your produce that same year, and you shall store it within your towns.

verses.kjv: And the Levite, (because he hath no part nor inheritance with thee,) and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, which are within thy gates, shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hand which thou doest.
verses.decoded: And the Levite (because he has no portion or inheritance with you), and the foreigner, and the orphan, and the widow who live in your towns, may come and eat and be satisfied, so that the LORD your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.

verses.kjv: At the end of every seven years thou shalt make a release.
verses.decoded: At the end of every seven years, you shall make a release.

verses.kjv: And this is the manner of the release: Every creditor that lendeth ought unto his neighbour shall release it; he shall not exact it of his neighbour, or of his brother; because it is called the LORD’s release.
verses.decoded: Every creditor who lends anything to his neighbor must release it; he must not demand repayment from his neighbor or his brother; because it is known as the Lord's release.

verses.kjv: Of a foreigner thou mayest exact it again: but that which is thine with thy brother thine hand shall release;
verses.decoded: You may demand repayment from a foreigner, but you must release what your brother owes you.

verses.kjv: Save when there shall be no poor among you; for the LORD shall greatly bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee for an inheritance to possess it:
verses.decoded: There should be no poor people among you, because the Lord will greatly bless you in the land that the Lord your God gives you as an inheritance.

verses.kjv: Only if thou carefully hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all these commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.decoded: Only if you carefully listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to diligently follow all these commands that I am giving you today.

verses.kjv: For the LORD thy God blesseth thee, as he promised thee: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, but thou shalt not borrow; and thou shalt reign over many nations, but they shall not reign over thee.
verses.decoded: For the LORD your God blesses you, as he promised you: and you will lend to many nations, but you will not borrow; and you will reign over many nations, but they will not reign over you.

verses.kjv: If there be among you a poor man of one of thy brethren within any of thy gates in thy land which the LORD thy God giveth thee, thou shalt not harden thine heart, nor shut thine hand from thy poor brother:
verses.decoded: If there is a poor person among you, one of your relatives within any of your towns in your land that the Lord your God is giving you, you must not be unfeeling or refuse to help your poor relative:

verses.kjv: But thou shalt open thine hand wide unto him, and shalt surely lend him sufficient for his need, in that which he wanteth.
verses.decoded: But you shall open your hand wide to him, and shall certainly lend him enough for his need, in that which he needs.

verses.kjv: Beware that there be not a thought in thy wicked heart, saying, The seventh year, the year of release, is at hand; and thine eye be evil against thy poor brother, and thou givest him nought; and he cry unto the LORD against thee, and it be sin unto thee.
verses.decoded: Be careful that you do not have a wicked thought in your heart, saying, 'The seventh year, the year of release, is near,' and you look unfavorably upon your poor brother, or your poor verses.kjv: Thou shalt surely give him, and thine heart shall not be grieved when thou givest unto him: because that for this thing the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thy works, and in all that thou puttest thine hand unto.
verses.decoded: You must certainly give to him, and your heart should not be saddened when you give to him, because for this action the Lord your God will bless you in all your work and in everything you undertake.

verses.kjv: For the poor shall never cease out of the land: therefore I command thee, saying, Thou shalt open thine hand wide unto thy brother, to thy poor, and to thy needy, in thy land.
verses.decoded: Because there will always be poor people in the land, therefore I command you, saying, you shall generously help your brother, your poor, and your needy, in your land.

verses.kjv: And if thy brother, an Hebrew man, or an Hebrew woman, be sold unto thee, and serve thee six years; then in the seventh year thou shalt let him go free from thee.
verses.decoded: And if your brother, a Hebrew man, or a Hebrew woman, is sold to you and serves you six years, then in the seventh year you shall let him go free from you.

verses.kjv: And when thou sendest him out free from thee, thou shalt not let him go away empty:
verses.decoded: And when you send him out free from you, you shall not let him go away empty.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
verses.decoded: You must provide for him generously from your flock, and from your threshing floor, and from your winepress: from what the Lord your God has blessed you with.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee: therefore I command thee this thing to day.
verses.decoded: And you shall remember that you were a slave in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God redeemed you; therefore I command you this thing today.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, if he say unto thee, I will not go away from thee; because he loveth thee and thine house, because he is well with thee;
verses.decoded: And if he says to you, I will not leave you; because he loves you and your household, because he is content with you.

verses.kjv: Then thou shalt take an aul, and thrust it through his ear unto the door, and he shall be thy servant for ever. And also unto thy maidservant thou shalt do likewise.
verses.decoded: Then you shall take an awl, and thrust it through his ear to the door, and he shall be your servant forever: and also to your female servant you shall do likewise.

verses.kjv: It shall not seem hard unto thee, when thou sendest him away free from thee; for he hath been worth a double hired servant to thee, in serving thee six years: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all that thou doest.
verses.decoded: It should not seem difficult to you when you send him away free from you; for he has been worth twice the wages of a hired servant to you, having served you six years. And when you send him away free from you, you must not let him go away empty.

verses.kjv: All the firstling males that come of thy herd and of thy flock thou shalt sanctify unto the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work with the firstling of thy bullock, nor shear the firstling of thy sheep.
verses.decoded: All the firstborn males that are born from your herd and from your flock you shall dedicate to the LORD your God: you shall do no work with the firstborn of your young bull, nor cut the wool from the firstborn of your sheep.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt eat it before the LORD thy God year by year in the place which the LORD shall choose, thou and thy household.
verses.decoded: You shall eat it before the LORD your God year by year in the place which the LORD chooses, you and your household.

verses.kjv: And if there be any blemish therein, as if it be lame, or blind, or have any ill blemish, thou shalt not sacrifice it unto the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: And if there is any defect in it, such as if it is lame, or blind, or has any serious defect, you must not sacrifice it to the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt eat it within thy gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, as the roebuck, and as the hart.
verses.decoded: You shall eat it within your gates: the unclean and the clean person shall eat it alike, like the roebuck and the deer.

verses.kjv: Only thou shalt not eat the blood thereof; thou shalt pour it upon the ground as water.
verses.decoded: However, you must not eat its blood; you must pour it on the ground like water.

verses.kjv: Observe the month of Abib, and keep the passover unto the LORD thy God: for in the month of Abib the LORD thy God brought thee forth out of Egypt by night.
verses.decoded: Observe the month of Abib, and celebrate the Passover to the LORD your God, because in the month of Abib the LORD your God brought you out of Egypt by night.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt therefore sacrifice the passover unto the LORD thy God, of the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD shall choose to place his name there.
verses.decoded: You shall therefore sacrifice the Passover to the LORD your God, from the flock and the herd, in the place which the LORD will choose to establish his presence there.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt eat no leavened bread with it; seven days shalt thou eat unleavened bread therewith, even the bread of affliction; for thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt in haste: that thou mayest remember the day when thou camest forth out of the land of Egypt all the days of thy life.
verses.decoded: You shall eat no leavened bread with it; for seven days you shall eat unleavened bread with it, which is the bread of affliction, because you came out of the land of Egypt in haste.

verses.kjv: And there shall be no leavened bread seen with thee in all thy coast seven days; neither shall there any thing of the flesh, which thou sacrificedst the first day at even, remain all night until the morning.
verses.decoded: And no leavened bread will be seen with you in all your territory for seven days; nor will any part of the meat which you sacrificed on the first day in the evening remain overnight until morning.

verses.kjv: Thou mayest not sacrifice the passover within any of thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee:
verses.decoded: You are not to sacrifice the Passover within any of your towns that the LORD your God gives you.

verses.kjv: But at the place which the LORD thy God shall choose to place his name in, there thou shalt sacrifice the passover at even, at the going down of the sun, at the season that thou camest forth out of Egypt.
verses.decoded: However, at the place which the Lord your God will choose to establish his presence, there you shall sacrifice the Passover in the evening, at sunset, at the time when you came out of Egypt.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt roast and eat it in the place which the LORD thy God shall choose: and thou shalt turn in the morning, and go unto thy tents.
verses.decoded: You shall roast and eat it in the place which the LORD your God shall choose; and you shall turn in the morning and go to your tents.

verses.kjv: Six days thou shalt eat unleavened bread: and on the seventh day shall be a solemn assembly to the LORD thy God: thou shalt do no work therein.
verses.decoded: For six days you shall eat unleavened bread. On the seventh day there shall be a solemn assembly to the Lord your God; you shall do no work on it.

verses.kjv: Seven weeks shalt thou number unto thee: begin to number the seven weeks from such time as thou beginnest to put the sickle to the corn.
verses.decoded: You shall count seven weeks for yourselves: begin to count the seven weeks from the time you begin to put the sickle to the grain.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt keep the feast of weeks unto the LORD thy God with a tribute of a freewill offering of thine hand, which thou shalt give unto the LORD thy God, according as the LORD thy God hath blessed thee:
verses.decoded: And you shall observe the Feast of Weeks to the LORD your God with a tribute of a freewill offering from your hand, which you shall give to the LORD your God, according to how the LORD your God has blessed you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt rejoice before the LORD thy God, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite that is within thy gates, and the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are among you, in the place which the LORD thy God hath chosen to place his name there.
verses.decoded: You shall celebrate before the Lord your God, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male servant, and your female servant, and the Levite who is within your towns, and the foreigner, and the orphan, and the widow who are among you, in the place which the Lord your God has chosen to establish his presence there.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt: and thou shalt observe and do these statutes.
verses.decoded: And you shall remember that you were a slave in Egypt, and you shall observe and follow these laws.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt observe the feast of tabernacles seven days, after that thou hast gathered in thy corn and thy wine:
verses.decoded: You must observe the Feast of Tabernacles for seven days, after you have gathered in your grain and your wine.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt rejoice in thy feast, thou, and thy son, and thy daughter, and thy manservant, and thy maidservant, and the Levite, the stranger, and the fatherless, and the widow, that are within thy gates.
verses.decoded: And you shall rejoice in your feast, you, and your son, and your daughter, and your male servant, and your female servant, and the Levite, the foreigner, and the fatherless, and the widow, who are within your gates.

verses.kjv: Seven days shalt thou keep a solemn feast unto the LORD thy God in the place which the LORD shall choose: because the LORD thy God shall bless thee in all thine increase, and in all the works of thine hands, therefore thou shalt surely rejoice.
verses.decoded: For seven days you shall observe a solemn feast to the LORD your God in the place which the LORD will choose, because the LORD your God will bless you in all your produce and in all the work of your hands; therefore you shall surely rejoice.

verses.kjv: Three times in a year shall all thy males appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose; in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tabernacles: and they shall not appear before the LORD empty:
verses.decoded: Three times a year all your males must appear before the LORD your God in the place which he chooses; at the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and at the Feast of Weeks, and at the Feast of Tabernacles: and they must not appear before the LORD empty.

verses.kjv: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
verses.decoded: Every man should give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD your God which he has given you.

verses.kjv: Judges and officers shalt thou make thee in all thy gates, which the LORD thy God giveth thee, throughout thy tribes: and they shall judge the people with just judgment.
verses.decoded: You are to appoint judges and officials for yourselves in all your cities, which the LORD your God is giving you, throughout your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not wrest judgment; thou shalt not respect persons, neither take a gift: for a gift doth blind the eyes of the wise, and pervert the words of the righteous.
verses.decoded: You must not pervert justice; you must not show favoritism, nor accept a bribe: because a bribe blinds the eyes of the wise, and distorts the words.

verses.kjv: That which is altogether just shalt thou follow, that thou mayest live, and inherit the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.decoded: You must pursue what is completely just, so that you may live and inherit the land that the Lord your God gives you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not plant thee a grove of any trees near unto the altar of the LORD thy God, which thou shalt make thee.
verses.decoded: You shall not plant for yourself a grove of any trees near to the altar of the LORD your God, which you shall make for yourself.

verses.kjv: Neither shalt thou set thee up any image; which the LORD thy God hateth.
verses.decoded: You shall not set up any image, which the LORD your God hates.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt not sacrifice unto the LORD thy God any bullock, or sheep, wherein is blemish, or any evilfavouredness: for that is an abomination unto the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: You shall not sacrifice to the LORD your God any bull or sheep in which there is a defect, or any disfigurement, because that is detestable to the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: If there be found among you, within any of thy gates which the LORD thy God giveth thee, man or woman, that hath wrought wickedness in the sight of the LORD thy God, in transgressing his covenant,
verses.decoded: If there is found among you, within any of your cities which the LORD your God gives you, a man or a woman, who has done evil in the eyes of the LORD your God, by breaking his covenant,

verses.kjv: And hath gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;
verses.decoded: And has gone and served other gods, and worshipped them, either the sun, or moon, or any of the host of heaven, which I have not commanded;

verses.kjv: And it be told thee, and thou hast heard of it, and enquired diligently, and, behold, it be true, and the thing certain, that such abomination is wrought in Israel:
verses.decoded: And if it is reported to you, and you have heard about it, and investigated thoroughly, and indeed, it is true, and the matter is certain, that such an abomination has been committed in Israel:

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou bring forth that man or that woman, which have committed that wicked thing, unto thy gates, even that man or that woman, and shalt stone them with stones, till they die.
verses.decoded: Then you shall bring out to your city gates that man or that woman who has committed that wicked act, even that man or that woman, and you shall stone them with stones until they die.

verses.kjv: At the mouth of two witnesses, or three witnesses, shall he that is worthy of death be put to death; but at the mouth of one witness he shall not be put to death.
verses.decoded: Based on the testimony of two witnesses, or three witnesses, the one who deserves death must be executed; but based on the testimony of one witness, he must not be executed.

verses.kjv: The hands of the witnesses shall be first upon him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. So thou shalt put the evil away from among you.
verses.decoded: The witnesses' hands must be the first to be laid on him to put him to death, and afterward the hands of all the people. In this way, you must remove the evil.

verses.kjv: If there arise a matter too hard for thee in judgment, between blood and blood, between plea and plea, and between stroke and stroke, being matters of controversy within thy gates: then shalt thou arise, and get thee up into the place which the LORD thy God shall choose;
verses.decoded: If a matter is too difficult for you to judge, such as disputes involving bloodshed, legal claims, or physical injuries, which are controversial issues within your towns: then you must go up to the place which the LORD your God will choose;

verses.kjv: And thou shalt come unto the priests the Levites, and unto the judge that shall be in those days, and enquire; and they shall shew thee the sentence of judgment:
verses.decoded: And you shall go to the priests, the Levites, and to the judge who is in office in those days, and inquire; and they will declare the verdict to you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt do according to the sentence, which they of that place which the LORD shall choose shall shew thee; and thou shalt observe to do according to all that they inform thee:
verses.decoded: And you shall act according to the judgment that those from the place which the LORD will choose will declare to you; and you shall be careful to do it.

verses.kjv: According to the sentence of the law which they shall teach thee, and according to the judgment which they shall tell thee, thou shalt do: thou shalt not decline from the sentence which they shall shew thee, to the right hand, nor to the left.
