verses.decoded: You will be blessed in the city, and you will be blessed in the field.

verses.kjv: Blessed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy ground, and the fruit of thy cattle, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.decoded: Your children will be blessed, and the produce of your land, and the offspring of your livestock, the increase of your cows, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.kjv: Blessed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.decoded: Your basket and your store will be blessed.

verses.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.decoded: You will be blessed when you come in, and you will be blessed when you go out.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thine enemies that rise up against thee to be smitten before thy face: they shall come out against thee one way, and flee before thee seven ways.
verses.decoded: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be defeated before you: they will come out against you in one direction, and flee from you in seven directions.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall command the blessing upon thee in thy storehouses, and in all that thou settest thine hand unto; and he shall bless thee in the land which the LORD thy God giveth thee.
verses.decoded: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your storehouses, and in all that you undertake; and he will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you as a possession.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall establish thee an holy people unto himself, as he hath sworn unto thee, if thou shalt keep the commandments of the LORD thy God, and walk in his ways.
verses.decoded: The LORD will establish you as a holy people for himself, just as he has sworn to you, if you keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

verses.kjv: And all people of the earth shall see that thou art called by the name of the LORD; and they shall be afraid of thee.
verses.decoded: And all people of the earth will see that you are called by the name of the LORD; and they will be afraid of you.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee plenteous in goods, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy ground, in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers to give thee.
verses.decoded: And the Lord will make you abundant in possessions, in the offspring of your body, and in the offspring of your livestock, and in the produce of your land, in the land that the Lord promised to your ancestors to give you.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand: and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow.
verses.decoded: The LORD will open to you his good treasure, the heavens to give rain to your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand: and you will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall make thee the head, and not the tail; and thou shalt be above only, and thou shalt not be beneath; if that thou hearken unto the commandments of the LORD thy God, which I command thee this day, to observe and to do them:
verses.decoded: And the Lord will make you the leader, and not the follower; and you will be above only, and you will not be beneath; if you listen to the commands of the Lord your God, which I give you this day, to observe and to do them:

verses.kjv: And thou shalt not go aside from any of the words which I command thee this day, to the right hand, or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
verses.decoded: And you shall not turn away from any of the words that I command you today, to the right or to the left, to follow other gods and serve them.

verses.kjv: But it shall come to pass, if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee:
verses.decoded: But it will happen, if you will not listen to the voice of the Lord your God, to diligently follow all his commands and his decrees that I am giving you today, then all these curses will come upon you and overwhelm you.

verses.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be in the city, and cursed shalt thou be in the field.
verses.decoded: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

verses.kjv: Cursed shall be thy basket and thy store.
verses.decoded: Your basket and your store will be cursed.

verses.kjv: Cursed shall be the fruit of thy body, and the fruit of thy land, the increase of thy kine, and the flocks of thy sheep.
verses.decoded: Cursed shall be the offspring of your body, and the produce of your land, the increase of your cattle, and the flocks of your sheep.

verses.kjv: Cursed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and cursed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
verses.decoded: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall send upon thee cursing, vexation, and rebuke, in all that thou settest thine hand unto for to do, until thou be destroyed, and until thou perish quickly; because of the wickedness of thy doings, whereby thou hast forsaken me.
verses.decoded: The LORD will send upon you curses, trouble, and strong disapproval in everything you undertake to do, until you are destroyed and quickly perish; because of the wickedness of your actions, by which you have abandoned me.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the pestilence cleave unto thee, until he have consumed thee from off the land, whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.decoded: The Lord will cause the plague to cling to you until he has destroyed you from the land where you are going to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with a consumption, and with a fever, and with an inflammation, and with an extreme burning, and with the sword, and with blasting, and with mildew; and they shall pursue thee until thou perish.
verses.decoded: The LORD will strike you with a wasting disease, and with a fever, and with inflammation, and with intense heat, and with the sword, and with blight, and with mildew; and they will pursue you until you perish.

verses.kjv: And thy heaven that is over thy head shall be brass, and the earth that is under thee shall be iron.
verses.decoded: And your sky that is above your head will be brass, and the ground that is beneath you will be iron.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall make the rain of thy land powder and dust: from heaven shall it come down upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.decoded: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust; from heaven it will come down upon you until you are destroyed.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall cause thee to be smitten before thine enemies: thou shalt go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them: and shalt be removed into all the kingdoms of the earth.
verses.decoded: The LORD will cause you to be defeated before your enemies: you will go out one way against them, and flee seven ways before them, and will be scattered into all the kingdoms of the earth.

verses.kjv: And thy carcase shall be meat unto all fowls of the air, and unto the beasts of the earth, and no man shall fray them away.
verses.decoded: And your dead body will be food for all the birds of the air, and for the animals of the earth, and no one will scare them away.

verses.kjv: The LORD will smite thee with the botch of Egypt, and with the emerods, and with the scab, and with the itch, whereof thou canst not be healed.
verses.decoded: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, and with tumors, and with scabies, and with itching, from which you cannot be cured.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee with madness, and blindness, and astonishment of heart:
verses.decoded: The Lord will strike you with madness, and blindness, and confusion of mind.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt grope at noonday, as the blind gropeth in darkness, and thou shalt not prosper in thy ways: and thou shalt be only oppressed and spoiled evermore, and no man shall save thee.
verses.decoded: And you will grope at midday, like the blind grope in darkness. You will not succeed in your endeavors, and you will always be oppressed and plundered.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her: thou shalt build an house, and thou shalt not dwell therein: thou shalt plant a vineyard, and shalt not gather the grapes thereof.
verses.decoded: You will become engaged to a wife, but another man will sleep with her. You will build a house, but you will not live in it. You will plant a vineyard, but you will not gather its grapes.

verses.kjv: Thine ox shall be slain before thine eyes, and thou shalt not eat thereof: thine ass shall be violently taken away from before thy face, and shall not be restored to thee: thy sheep shall be given unto thine enemies, and thou shalt have none to rescue them.
verses.decoded: Your ox shall be killed before your eyes, and you shall not eat of it: your donkey shall be violently taken away from before your face, and shall not be returned to you: your sheep shall be given to your enemies, and you shall have no one to rescue them.

verses.kjv: Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people, and thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long: and there shall be no might in thine hand:
verses.decoded: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people, and your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all day long; and there will be no strength in your hand.

verses.kjv: The fruit of thy land, and all thy labours, shall a nation which thou knowest not eat up; and thou shalt be only oppressed and crushed alway:
verses.decoded: The produce of your land and all your hard work a nation you do not know will consume; and you will only be oppressed and crushed continually.

verses.kjv: So that thou shalt be mad for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.decoded: So that you will be driven mad because of the sight that your eyes will see.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall smite thee in the knees, and in the legs, with a sore botch that cannot be healed, from the sole of thy foot unto the top of thy head.
verses.decoded: The Lord will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a painful sore that cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the top of your head.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring thee, and thy king which thou shalt set over thee, unto a nation which neither thou nor thy fathers have known; and there shalt thou serve other gods, wood and stone.
verses.decoded: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that neither you nor your ancestors have known; and there you will serve other gods, made of wood and stone.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations whither the LORD shall lead thee.
verses.decoded: And you will become an object of astonishment, a proverb, and a byword, among all nations where the Lord will lead you.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt carry much seed out into the field, and shalt gather but little in; for the locust shall consume it.
verses.decoded: You will carry much seed out into the field, but you will gather very little, because the locust will eat it.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt plant vineyards, and dress them, but shalt neither drink of the wine, nor gather the grapes; for the worms shall eat them.
verses.decoded: You will plant vineyards and cultivate them, but you will neither drink the wine nor gather the grapes, because worms will eat them.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt have olive trees throughout all thy coasts, but thou shalt not anoint thyself with the oil; for thine olive shall cast his fruit.
verses.decoded: You will have olive trees throughout all your territories, but you will not anoint yourselves with the oil; because your olive trees will drop their fruit.

verses.kjv: Thou shalt beget sons and daughters, but thou shalt not enjoy them; for they shall go into captivity.
verses.decoded: You will have sons and daughters, but you will not enjoy them, because they will be taken captive.

verses.kjv: All thy trees and fruit of thy land shall the locust consume.
verses.decoded: All your trees and the fruit of your land the locust will consume.

verses.kjv: The stranger that is within thee shall get up above thee very high; and thou shalt come down very low.
verses.decoded: The foreigner who is among you will rise very high above you, and you will sink very low.

verses.kjv: He shall lend to thee, and thou shalt not lend to him: he shall be the head, and thou shalt be the tail.
verses.decoded: He will lend to you, and you will not lend to him: he will be the head, and you will be the tail.

verses.kjv: Moreover all these curses shall come upon thee, and shall pursue thee, and overtake thee, till thou be destroyed; because thou hearkenedst not unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded thee:
verses.decoded: Furthermore, all these curses will come upon you, and will pursue you, and overtake you, until you are destroyed; because you did not listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

verses.kjv: And they shall be upon thee for a sign and for a wonder, and upon thy seed for ever.
verses.decoded: And they will be upon you as a sign and as a wonder, and upon your descendants forever.

verses.kjv: Because thou servedst not the LORD thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things;
verses.decoded: Because you did not serve the LORD your God with joy and with a glad heart, despite the abundance of all things.

verses.kjv: Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies which the LORD shall send against thee, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things: and he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.decoded: Therefore you shall serve your enemies whom the LORD will send against you, in hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in need of all things: and he will put an iron yoke upon your neck, until he has destroyed you.

verses.kjv: The LORD shall bring a nation against thee from far, from the end of the earth, as swift as the eagle flieth; a nation whose tongue thou shalt not understand;
verses.decoded: The LORD will bring a nation against you from a distant place, from the end of the earth, as swiftly as an eagle flies; a nation whose language you will not understand.

verses.kjv: A nation of fierce countenance, which shall not regard the person of the old, nor shew favour to the young:
verses.decoded: A nation with a stern appearance, that will not respect the elderly, nor show kindness to the young.

verses.kjv: And he shall eat the fruit of thy cattle, and the fruit of thy land, until thou be destroyed: which also shall not leave thee either corn, wine, or oil, or the increase of thy kine, or flocks of thy sheep, until he have destroyed thee.
verses.decoded: And he will consume the produce of your livestock and the crops of your land until you are ruined. He will also not leave you any grain, new wine, or olive oil, nor the offspring of your cattle or the flocks of your sheep, until he has destroyed you.

verses.kjv: And he shall besiege thee in all thy gates, until thy high and fenced walls come down, wherein thou trustedst, throughout all thy land: and he shall besiege thee in all thy gates throughout all thy land, which the LORD thy God hath given thee.
verses.decoded: And he will besiege you in all your cities, until your high and fortified walls come down, in which you trusted, throughout all your land: and he will eat the offspring of your livestock, and the produce of your ground, until you are destroyed: who also will not leave you either grain, wine, or oil, or the offspring of your cattle, or the flocks of your sheep, until he has destroyed you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt eat the fruit of thine own body, the flesh of thy sons and of thy daughters, which the LORD thy God hath given thee, in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee:
verses.decoded: And you shall eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and your daughters, which the LORD your God has given you, in the siege, and in the distress, with which your enemies shall distress you.

verses.kjv: So that the man that is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye shall be evil toward his brother, and toward the wife of his bosom, and toward the remnant of his children which he shall leave:
verses.decoded: So that the man among you who is tender and very delicate will look with hostility toward his brother, and toward the wife he cherishes, and toward the remaining children he has left:

verses.kjv: So that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he shall eat: because he hath nothing left him in the siege, and in the straitness, wherewith thine enemies shall distress thee in all thy gates.
verses.decoded: So that he will not give to any of them from the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left during the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you in all your cities.

verses.kjv: The tender and delicate woman among you, which would not adventure to set the sole of her foot upon the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye shall be evil toward the husband of her bosom, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,
verses.decoded: Among you, the tender and delicate woman who would not dare to set the sole of her foot on the ground because of her delicacy and tenderness, will look with hostility toward the husband she cherishes, and toward her son, and toward her daughter,

verses.kjv: And toward her young one that cometh out from between her feet, and toward her children which she shall bear: for she shall eat them for want of all things secretly in the siege and straitness, wherewith thine enemy shall distress thee in thy gates.
verses.decoded: And toward her newborn that comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she will bear: for she will eat them secretly because of the lack of everything during the siege and hardship, with which your enemies will distress you in your cities.

verses.kjv: If thou wilt not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that thou mayest fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD THY GOD;
verses.decoded: If you will not be careful to obey all the words of this law that are written in this book, so that you may fear this glorious and awe-inspiring name, THE LORD YOUR GOD.

verses.kjv: Then the LORD will make thy plagues wonderful, and the plagues of thy seed, even great plagues, and of long continuance, and sore sicknesses, and of long continuance.
verses.decoded: If you will not be careful to follow all the words of this law which are written in this book, so that you may fear this glorious and awe-inspiring name, THE LORD YOUR GOD; Then the LORD will make your afflictions extraordinary, and the afflictions of your descendants, even severe afflictions, and of long duration, and grievous illnesses, and of long duration.

verses.kjv: Moreover he will bring upon thee all the diseases of Egypt, which thou wast afraid of; and they shall cleave unto thee.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, he will inflict upon you all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

verses.kjv: Also every sickness, and every plague, which is not written in the book of this law, them will the LORD bring upon thee, until thou be destroyed.
verses.decoded: Also, every sickness and every plague that is not recorded in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them upon you until you are destroyed.

verses.kjv: And ye shall be left few in number, whereas ye were as the stars of heaven for multitude; because thou wouldest not obey the voice of the LORD thy God.
verses.decoded: And you will be left few in number, even though you were as numerous as the stars of heaven, because you would not obey the voice of the Lord your God.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you; so the LORD will rejoice over you to destroy you, and to bring you to nought; and ye shall be plucked from off the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.decoded: And it will happen that just as the Lord took pleasure in doing good for you and making you numerous, so the Lord will take pleasure in destroying you and bringing you to nothing; and you will be removed from the land where you are going to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall scatter thee among all people, from the one end of the earth even unto the other; and there thou shalt serve other gods, which neither thou nor thy fathers have known, even wood and stone.
verses.decoded: And the LORD will scatter you among all people, from one end of the earth to the other; and there you will serve other gods, which neither you nor your ancestors have known, indeed, wood and stone.

verses.kjv: And among these nations shalt thou find no ease, neither shall the sole of thy foot have rest: but the LORD shall give thee there a trembling heart, and failing of eyes, and sorrow of mind:
verses.decoded: And among these nations you will find no peace, nor will the sole of your foot have rest: but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, and failing eyesight, and sorrow of mind:

verses.kjv: And thy life shall hang in doubt before thee; and thou shalt fear day and night, and shalt have none assurance of thy life:
verses.decoded: And your life will be uncertain before you; and you will fear day and night, and will have no certainty about your life.

verses.kjv: In the morning thou shalt say, Would God it were even! and at even thou shalt say, Would God it were morning! for the fear of thine heart wherewith thou shalt fear, and for the sight of thine eyes which thou shalt see.
verses.decoded: In the morning you will say, 'I wish it were evening!' and in the evening you will say, 'I wish it were morning!' because of the fear in your heart that will make you afraid, and because of the things your eyes will see.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships, by the way whereof I spake unto thee, Thou shalt see it no more again: and there ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen, and no man shall buy you.
verses.decoded: And the LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I spoke to you, 'You will not see it again.' And there you will be sold to your enemies as enslaved men and women, and no one will buy you.

verses.kjv: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
verses.decoded: These are the words of the agreement that the LORD commanded Moses to establish with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the agreement he made with them at Horeb.

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto all Israel, and said unto them, Ye have seen all that the LORD did before your eyes in the land of Egypt unto Pharaoh, and unto all his servants, and unto all his land;
verses.decoded: Moses summoned all of Israel and told them, "You have seen everything the Lord did before your eyes in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh."

verses.kjv: The great temptations which thine eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:
verses.decoded: The great trials which your eyes have seen, the signs, and those great miracles:

verses.kjv: Yet the LORD hath not given you an heart to perceive, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, unto this day.
verses.decoded: Yet the LORD has not given you a heart to understand, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, until this day.

verses.kjv: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes are not waxen old upon you, and thy shoe is not waxen old upon thy foot.
verses.decoded: And I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes have not worn out on you, and your shoe has not worn out on your foot.

verses.kjv: Ye have not eaten bread, neither have ye drunk wine or strong drink: that ye might know that I am the LORD your God.
verses.decoded: You have not eaten bread, nor have you drunk wine or strong drink, so that you might know that I am the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: And when ye came unto this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us unto battle, and we smote them:
verses.decoded: And when you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan, came out against us for battle, and we defeated them.

verses.kjv: And we took their land, and gave it for an inheritance unto the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: And we took their land, and gave it as an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half tribe of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that ye may prosper in all that ye do.
verses.decoded: Therefore, keep the words of this covenant and do them, so that you may succeed in everything you do.

verses.kjv: Ye stand this day all of you before the LORD your God; your captains of your tribes, your elders, and your officers, with all the men of Israel,
verses.decoded: You stand today, all of you, before the LORD your God: your leaders of your tribes, your elders, and your officials, with all the men of Israel,

verses.kjv: Your little ones, your wives, and thy stranger that is in thy camp, from the hewer of thy wood unto the drawer of thy water:
verses.decoded: Your children, your wives, and the foreigner who is in your camp, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water:

verses.kjv: That thou shouldest enter into covenant with the LORD thy God, and into his oath, which the LORD thy God maketh with thee this day:
verses.decoded: So that you may enter into a covenant with the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God is making with you today.

verses.kjv: That he may establish thee to day for a people unto himself, and that he may be unto thee a God, as he hath said unto thee, and as he hath sworn unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
verses.decoded: That he may establish you today as a people for himself, and that he may be your God, as he has said to you, and as he has sworn to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

verses.kjv: Neither with you only do I make this covenant and this oath;
verses.decoded: I am making this agreement and this promise not only with you;

verses.kjv: But with him that standeth here with us this day before the LORD our God, and also with him that is not here with us this day:
verses.decoded: But with those who are standing here with us today before the Lord our God, and also with those who are not here with us today:

verses.kjv: (For ye know how we have dwelt in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which ye passed by;
verses.decoded: For you know how we lived in the land of Egypt; and how we came through the nations which you passed by;

verses.kjv: And ye have seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them:)
verses.decoded: And you have seen their detestable practices and their idols made of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them.

verses.kjv: Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turneth away this day from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; lest there should be among you a root that beareth gall and wormwood;
verses.decoded: So that there is not among you a man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go and serve the gods of these nations; so that there is not among you a root that produces gall and wormwood.

verses.kjv: And it come to pass, when he heareth the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, I shall have peace, though I walk in the imagination of mine heart, to add drunkenness to thirst:
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he reassures himself in his heart, saying, 'I will have peace, even though I follow the stubbornness of my heart, adding drunkenness to thirst.'

verses.kjv: The LORD will not spare him, but then the anger of the LORD and his jealousy shall smoke against that man, and all the curses that are written in this book shall lie upon him, and the LORD shall blot out his name from under heaven.
verses.decoded: The LORD will not forgive him, but then the LORD's anger and jealousy will burn against that man, and all the curses written in this book will fall upon him, and the LORD will erase his name from under heaven.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall separate him unto evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that are written in this book of the law:
verses.decoded: And the LORD will set him apart for misfortune from all the tribes of Israel, in accordance with all the curses of the agreement that are written in this book of the law.

verses.kjv: So that the generation to come of your children that shall rise up after you, and the stranger that shall come from a far land, shall say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses which the LORD hath laid upon it;
verses.decoded: So that the coming generation of your children who will grow up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a distant land, will say, when they see the disasters of that land, and the illnesses which the Lord has inflicted upon it;

verses.kjv: And that the whole land thereof is brimstone, and salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor beareth, nor any grass groweth therein, like the overthrow of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath:
verses.decoded: And that the entire land is sulfur, and salt, and burning, so that it is not planted, nor does it produce, nor does any grass grow there, like the destruction of Sodom, and Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboim, which the LORD destroyed in his anger and in his wrath:

verses.kjv: Even all nations shall say, Wherefore hath the LORD done thus unto this land? what meaneth the heat of this great anger?
verses.decoded: Even all nations will say, 'Why has the LORD done this to this land? What is the cause of this great anger?'

verses.kjv: Then men shall say, Because they have forsaken the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them forth out of the land of Egypt:
verses.decoded: Then people will say, 'Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD God of their fathers, which he made with them when he led them out of the land of Egypt;'

verses.kjv: For they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they knew not, and whom he had not given unto them:
verses.decoded: Because they went and served other gods, and worshipped them, gods whom they did not know, and whom he had not given to them.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the LORD was kindled against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:
verses.decoded: And the Lord's anger was ignited against this land, to bring upon it all the curses that are written in this book:

verses.kjv: And the LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and cast them into another land, as it is this day.
verses.decoded: And the LORD removed them from their land in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation, and sent them into another land, as it is today.

verses.kjv: The secret things belong unto the LORD our God: but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.
verses.decoded: The secret matters belong to the Lord our God, but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, so that we may obey all the words of this law.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when all these things are come upon thee, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before thee, and thou shalt call them to mind among all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath driven thee,
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when all these things have happened to you, the blessing and the curse, which I have presented to you, and you remember them among all the nations, where the LORD your God has driven you.

verses.kjv: And shalt return unto the LORD thy God, and shalt obey his voice according to all that I command thee this day, thou and thy children, with all thine heart, and with all thy soul;
verses.decoded: And you shall return to the LORD your God, and shall obey his voice according to all that I command you this day, you and your children, with all your heart, and with all your soul;

verses.kjv: That then the LORD thy God will turn thy captivity, and have compassion upon thee, and will return and gather thee from all the nations, whither the LORD thy God hath scattered thee.
verses.decoded: Then the Lord your God will restore your fortunes, and will have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the nations where the Lord your God has scattered you.

verses.kjv: If any of thine be driven out unto the outmost parts of heaven, from thence will the LORD thy God gather thee, and from thence will he fetch thee:
verses.decoded: If any of your people are driven out to the farthest parts of heaven, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will bring thee into the land which thy fathers possessed, and thou shalt possess it; and he will do thee good, and multiply thee above thy fathers.
verses.decoded: And the Lord your God will bring you into the land which your ancestors occupied, and you shall occupy it; and he will do you good, and make you more numerous than your ancestors.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will circumcise thine heart, and the heart of thy seed, to love the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul, that thou mayest live.
verses.decoded: And the LORD your God will purify your heart and the heart of your descendants, so that you will love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, so that you may live.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will put all these curses upon thine enemies, and on them that hate thee, which persecuted thee.
verses.decoded: And the Lord your God will put all these curses upon your enemies, and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

verses.kjv: And thou shalt return and obey the voice of the LORD, and do all his commandments which I command thee this day.
verses.decoded: Then you will again obey the voice of the LORD and follow all his commands that I am giving you today.

verses.kjv: And the LORD thy God will make thee plenteous in every work of thine hand, in the fruit of thy body, and in the fruit of thy cattle, and in the fruit of thy land, for good: for the LORD will again rejoice over thee for good, as he rejoiced over thy fathers:
verses.decoded: And the Lord your God will make you prosperous in every work of your hand, in the offspring of your body, and in the offspring of your livestock, and in the produce of your land, for your well-being, to delight in you; for the Lord will again delight in you for your well-being, just as he delighted in your ancestors.

verses.kjv: If thou shalt hearken unto the voice of the LORD thy God, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, and if thou turn unto the LORD thy God with all thine heart, and with all thy soul.
verses.decoded: If you listen to the voice of the LORD your God, to keep his commands and his decrees which are written in this book of the law, and if you return to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

verses.kjv: For this commandment which I command thee this day, it is not hidden from thee, neither is it far off.
verses.decoded: For this commandment that I give you today, it is not hidden from you, nor is it far away.

verses.kjv: It is not in heaven, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go up for us to heaven, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.decoded: It is not in heaven, that you should say, Who will go up for us to heaven, and bring it to us, so that we can hear it and do it?

verses.kjv: Neither is it beyond the sea, that thou shouldest say, Who shall go over the sea for us, and bring it unto us, that we may hear it, and do it?
verses.decoded: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, 'Who will go over the sea for us and bring it to us, so that we can hear it and do it?'

verses.kjv: But the word is very nigh unto thee, in thy mouth, and in thy heart, that thou mayest do it.
verses.decoded: But the message is very near you, in your mouth and in your heart, so that you may do it.

verses.kjv: See, I have set before thee this day life and good, and death and evil;
verses.decoded: Look, I have placed before you today life and prosperity, and death and misfortune;

verses.kjv: In that I command thee this day to love the LORD thy God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commandments and his statutes and his judgments, that thou mayest live and multiply: and the LORD thy God shall bless thee in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
verses.decoded: Because I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways, and to keep his commands and his decrees and his laws, so that you may live and increase; and the LORD your God will bless you in the land where you are going to possess it.

verses.kjv: But if thine heart turn away, so that thou wilt not hear, but shalt be drawn away, and worship other gods, and serve them;
verses.decoded: But if your heart turns away, so that you will not listen, but will be led astray, and worship other gods, and serve them;

verses.kjv: I denounce unto you this day, that ye shall surely perish, and that ye shall not prolong your days upon the land, whither thou passest over Jordan to go to possess it.
verses.decoded: I declare to you today that you will certainly perish, and that you will not live long in the land where you are going across the Jordan River to take possession of it.

verses.kjv: I call heaven and earth to record this day against you, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and cursing: therefore choose life, that both thou and thy seed may live:
verses.decoded: I call heaven and earth to witness this day against you, that I have presented to you life and death, blessing and cursing; therefore choose life, so that both you and your descendants may live.

verses.kjv: That thou mayest love the LORD thy God, and that thou mayest obey his voice, and that thou mayest cleave unto him: for he is thy life, and the length of thy days: that thou mayest dwell in the land which the LORD sware unto thy fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
verses.decoded: So that you may love the LORD your God, and that you may obey his voice, and that you may remain loyal to him: for he is your life, and the length of your days: so that you may live in the land which the LORD promised to your ancestors, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give to them.

verses.kjv: And Moses went and spake these words unto all Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, I am an hundred and twenty years old this day; I can no more go out and come in: also the LORD hath said unto me, Thou shalt not go over this Jordan.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, I am one hundred and twenty years old today; I can no longer go out and come in: also the Lord has said to me, You shall not go over this Jordan.

verses.kjv: The LORD thy God, he will go over before thee, and he will destroy these nations from before thee, and thou shalt possess them: and Joshua, he shall go over before thee, as the LORD hath said.
verses.decoded: The LORD your God, he will go before you, and he will destroy these nations before you, and you will take possession of them: and Joshua, he will go before you, as the LORD has said.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall do unto them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and unto the land of them, whom he destroyed.
verses.decoded: And the Lord will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, kings of the Amorites, and to their land, which he destroyed.

verses.kjv: And the LORD shall give them up before your face, that ye may do unto them according unto all the commandments which I have commanded you.
verses.decoded: And the LORD will deliver them before you, so that you may do to them according to all the commands which I have commanded you.

verses.kjv: Be strong and of a good courage, fear not, nor be afraid of them: for the LORD thy God, he it is that doth go with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.decoded: Be strong and courageous, do not be afraid or terrified by them, because the LORD your God is the one who goes with you; he will not fail you or abandon you.

verses.kjv: And Moses called unto Joshua, and said unto him in the sight of all Israel, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou must go with this people unto the land which the LORD hath sworn unto their fathers to give them; and thou shalt cause them to inherit it.
verses.decoded: And Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the presence of all Israel, 'Be strong and courageous, for you must go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their ancestors to give them; and you will cause them to inherit it.'

verses.kjv: And the LORD, he it is that doth go before thee; he will be with thee, he will not fail thee, neither forsake thee: fear not, neither be dismayed.
verses.decoded: And the Lord, he is the one who goes before you; he will be with you, he will not fail you, nor abandon you: do not be afraid, nor be discouraged.

verses.kjv: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it unto the priests the sons of Levi, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and unto all the elders of Israel.
verses.decoded: And Moses wrote this law, and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and to all the elders of Israel.

verses.kjv: And Moses commanded them, saying, At the end of every seven years, in the solemnity of the year of release, in the feast of tabernacles,
verses.decoded: And Moses instructed them, saying, At the end of every seven years, during the celebration of the year of release, at the Feast of Tabernacles,

verses.kjv: When all Israel is come to appear before the LORD thy God in the place which he shall choose, thou shalt read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
verses.decoded: When all Israel comes to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel so they can hear it.

verses.kjv: Gather the people together, men, and women, and children, and thy stranger that is within thy gates, that they may hear, and that they may learn, and fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law:
verses.decoded: Assemble the people, men, women, and children, and the foreigner who lives within your gates, so that they may hear, and learn, and fear the Lord your God, and carefully follow all the words of this law.

verses.kjv: And that their children, which have not known any thing, may hear, and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as ye live in the land whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.decoded: So that their children, who have not known anything, may hear and learn to revere the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thy days approach that thou must die: call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tabernacle of the congregation, that I may give him a charge. And Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, "Look, your days are coming to an end, and you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the tent of meeting, so that I may give him instructions."

verses.kjv: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud: and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.
verses.decoded: And the LORD appeared in the tabernacle in a pillar of a cloud; and the pillar of the cloud stood over the door of the tabernacle.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Behold, thou shalt sleep with thy fathers; and this people will rise up, and go a whoring after the gods of the strangers of the land, whither they go to be among them, and will forsake me, and break my covenant which I have made with them.
verses.decoded: And the LORD said to Moses, 'Look, you will die and join your ancestors; and this people will rise up and worship the foreign gods of the land where they are going to live among them, and they will abandon me and violate my agreement that I made with them.'

verses.kjv: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall befall them; so that they will say in that day, Are not these evils come upon us, because our God is not among us?
verses.decoded: Then my anger will be ignited against them on that day, and I will abandon them, and I will conceal my presence from them, and they will be consumed, and many misfortunes and difficulties will happen to them; so that they will say on that day, Have not these misfortunes come upon us because our God is not among us?

verses.kjv: And I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evils which they shall have wrought, in that they are turned unto other gods.
verses.decoded: And I will certainly conceal myself on that day because of all the evil they will have done, since they have turned to other gods.

verses.kjv: Now therefore write ye this song for you, and teach it the children of Israel: put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: So now, you write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the Israelites; ensure they learn it, so that this song may be a witness for me against them.

verses.kjv: For when I shall have brought them into the land which I sware unto their fathers, that floweth with milk and honey; and they shall have eaten and filled themselves, and waxen fat; then will they turn unto other gods, and serve them, and provoke me, and break my covenant.
verses.decoded: For when I bring them into the land which I swore to their ancestors, a land that flows with milk and honey, and they eat and are satisfied and grow prosperous, then they will turn to other gods and serve them, and provoke me and break my covenant.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when many evils and troubles are befallen them, that this song shall testify against them as a witness; for it shall not be forgotten out of the mouths of their seed: for I know their imagination which they go about, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I sware.
verses.decoded: And it will happen that when many misfortunes and difficulties come upon them, this song will serve as a witness against them; because it will not be forgotten by their descendants. For I know their intentions and what they are doing, even now, before I have brought them into the land which I promised.

verses.kjv: Moses therefore wrote this song the same day, and taught it the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Moses therefore wrote this song on the same day and taught it to the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And he gave Joshua the son of Nun a charge, and said, Be strong and of a good courage: for thou shalt bring the children of Israel into the land which I sware unto them: and I will be with thee.
verses.decoded: And he gave Joshua, the son of Nun, a command, and said, 'Be strong and courageous, for you will bring the people of Israel into the land which I swore to them, and I will be with you.'

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when Moses had made an end of writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
verses.decoded: It happened that when Moses finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were completed,

verses.kjv: That Moses commanded the Levites, which bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, saying,
verses.decoded: Then Moses commanded the Levites, who carried the ark of the covenant of the Lord, saying,

verses.kjv: Take this book of the law, and put it in the side of the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, that it may be there for a witness against thee.
verses.decoded: Take this book of the law, and place it beside the ark of the covenant of the LORD your God, so that it may be there as a witness against you.

verses.kjv: For I know thy rebellion, and thy stiff neck: behold, while I am yet alive with you this day, ye have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?
verses.decoded: For I know your rebellion and your stubbornness: look, while I am still alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD; and how much more after my death?

verses.kjv: Gather unto me all the elders of your tribes, and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to record against them.
verses.decoded: Assemble for me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, so that I may speak these words for them to hear, and call upon heaven and earth to be witnesses against them.

verses.kjv: For I know that after my death ye will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn aside from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will befall you in the latter days; because ye will do evil in the sight of the LORD, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.
verses.decoded: Because I know that after my death you will completely corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the path I have commanded you; and disaster will come upon you in the future; because you will do evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke him to anger through your actions.

verses.kjv: And Moses spake in the ears of all the congregation of Israel the words of this song, until they were ended.
verses.decoded: And Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

verses.kjv: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.
verses.decoded: Listen, O heavens, and I will speak; and listen, O earth, to the words from my mouth.

verses.kjv: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:
verses.decoded: My teaching will fall like the rain, my words will settle gently like the dew, like light rain on the young plants, and like the showers on the grass.

verses.kjv: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.
verses.decoded: Because I will proclaim the name of the LORD: attribute greatness to our God.

verses.kjv: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.
verses.decoded: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: because all his actions are just: a God of truth and without wrongdoing, he is just and right.

verses.kjv: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.
verses.decoded: They have corrupted themselves; their blemish is not the blemish of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

verses.kjv: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?
verses.decoded: Do you repay the Lord in this way, you foolish and unwise people? Is he not your father who bought you? Has he not made you and established you?

verses.kjv: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.
verses.decoded: Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

verses.kjv: When the Most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: When the Most High assigned the nations their land, when he separated the descendants of Adam, he established the boundaries of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: For the LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
verses.decoded: Because the Lord's share is his people; Jacob is the portion of his inheritance.

verses.kjv: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.
verses.decoded: He found him in a desert land, and in the desolate, howling wilderness; he guided him, he taught him, he protected him as if he were the most precious thing.

verses.kjv: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:
verses.decoded: As an eagle rouses its nest, hovers over its young, spreads out its wings, takes them, and carries them on its wings:

verses.kjv: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.
verses.decoded: The LORD alone led him, and no foreign god was with him.

verses.kjv: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;
verses.decoded: He enabled him to travel over the high places of the earth, so that he could eat the produce of the fields; and he allowed him to draw honey from the rock, and oil from the hard rock.

verses.kjv: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.
verses.decoded: Butter from cattle, and milk from sheep, with the fat of lambs, and rams from the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest, richest wheat; and you drank the pure juice of the grape.

verses.kjv: But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.
verses.decoded: But Jeshurun grew prosperous and rebelled; you have grown prosperous, you have become stout, you are overflowing with abundance; then he abandoned God who created him, and showed contempt for the Rock of his salvation.

verses.kjv: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.
verses.decoded: They made him jealous with foreign gods, and they made him angry with detestable practices.

verses.kjv: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.
verses.decoded: They sacrificed to demons, not to God; to gods they did not know, to new gods that recently appeared, whom your ancestors did not fear.

verses.kjv: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.
verses.decoded: You have been unmindful of the Rock who brought you into being, and you have forgotten God who formed you.

verses.kjv: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
verses.decoded: And when the LORD saw it, he detested them, because his sons and his daughters provoked him.

verses.kjv: And he said, I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.
verses.decoded: And he said, I will hide my presence from them, I will see what their outcome will be: for they are a very disobedient generation, children in whom there is no faithfulness.

verses.kjv: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
verses.decoded: They have made me jealous with what is not God; they have made me angry with their worthless idols: and I will make them jealous with those who are not a people; I will make them angry with a foolish nation.

verses.kjv: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.
verses.decoded: Because a fire is ignited by my anger, and will burn down to the deepest part of the grave, and will consume the earth with its produce, and set the foundations of the mountains on fire.

verses.kjv: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.
verses.decoded: I will bring many troubles upon them; I will use my arrows against them.

verses.kjv: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.
verses.decoded: They will be consumed by hunger, and devoured by scorching heat, and with devastating destruction. I will also send wild animals to attack them, along with the venom of snakes that crawl on the ground.

verses.kjv: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.
verses.decoded: The sword outside, and terror inside, will destroy both the young man and the virgin, also the infant along with the elderly man.

verses.kjv: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:
verses.decoded: I said, I would scatter them into distant places, I would cause their memory to vanish from among people.

verses.kjv: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.
verses.decoded: If I had not been concerned about the enemy's anger, their opponents might have acted arrogantly, and they might have said, 'Our power is great, and the LORD has not done all this.'

verses.kjv: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.
verses.decoded: Because they are a nation without guidance, nor is there any understanding among them.

verses.kjv: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
verses.decoded: If only they were wise, and understood this, and would consider their final outcome!

verses.kjv: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?
verses.decoded: How could one person chase a thousand, and two people put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had abandoned them, and the LORD had given them up?

verses.kjv: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.
verses.decoded: Because their rock is not like our Rock, even our enemies themselves would acknowledge this.

verses.kjv: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:
verses.decoded: Because their vine comes from the vine of Sodom and from the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are poisonous, and their clusters are bitter:

verses.kjv: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.
verses.decoded: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

verses.kjv: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?
verses.decoded: Is this not stored away with me, and secured among my treasures?

verses.kjv: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.
verses.decoded: Vengeance and repayment belong to me; their foot will slip in due time, because the day of their disaster is near, and the things that will come upon them are approaching quickly.

verses.kjv: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.
verses.decoded: Because the LORD will judge his people and will have compassion for his servants when he sees that their strength is gone, and there is no one confined or remaining.

verses.kjv: And he shall say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,
verses.decoded: And he will say, Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

verses.kjv: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.
verses.decoded: Who ate the fat of their sacrifices and drank the wine of their drink offerings? Let them rise up and help you and be your protection.

verses.kjv: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.
verses.decoded: Understand now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: and no one can rescue from my hand.

verses.kjv: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.
verses.decoded: For I raise my hand to heaven, and say, I live forever.

verses.kjv: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.
verses.decoded: If I sharpen my shining sword, and my hand grasps judgment, I will bring vengeance upon my enemies and will repay those who hate me.

verses.kjv: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.
verses.decoded: I will make my arrows saturated with blood, and my sword will consume flesh; and that will be with the blood of those killed and of the prisoners, from the start of vengeance upon the enemy.

verses.kjv: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.
verses.decoded: Rejoice, all you nations, with his people, because he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will bring vengeance upon his adversaries, and will be merciful to his land and to his people.

verses.kjv: And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.
verses.decoded: And Moses came and spoke all the words of this song to the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

verses.kjv: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:
verses.decoded: And Moses finished speaking all these words to all Israel:

verses.kjv: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
verses.decoded: And he said to them, Pay close attention to all the words that I declare to you today, which you must command your children to carefully follow and do,

verses.kjv: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
verses.decoded: For it is not an empty matter for you; because it is your life: and through this matter you will extend your days in the land, to which you are crossing the Jordan.

verses.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

verses.kjv: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:
verses.decoded: Go up into this mountain Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is opposite Jericho; and look at the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the children of Israel as a possession:

verses.kjv: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:
verses.decoded: And you will die on the mountain where you are going up, and be gathered to your people; just as your brother Aaron died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people:

verses.kjv: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of MeribahKadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Because you sinned against me among the Israelites at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you did not treat me as holy among the Israelites.

verses.kjv: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
verses.decoded: Yet you will see the land before you; but you will not go there to the land which I give the children of Israel.

verses.kjv: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
verses.decoded: And this is the blessing with which Moses, the man of God, blessed the descendants of Israel before his death.

verses.kjv: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
verses.decoded: And he said, The LORD came from Sinai, and appeared from Seir to them; he shone brightly from Mount Paran, and he came with tens of thousands of holy ones: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.

verses.kjv: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
verses.decoded: Indeed, he loved the people; all his holy ones are in your hand: and they sat down at your feet; everyone will receive your words.

verses.kjv: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
verses.decoded: Moses gave us a law, which is the possession of the assembly of Jacob.

verses.kjv: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
verses.decoded: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the leaders of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.

verses.kjv: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
verses.decoded: Let Reuben live and not die, and let his men not be few.

verses.kjv: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
verses.decoded: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah, and bring him to his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be an help to him from his enemies.

verses.kjv: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
verses.decoded: And concerning Levi, he said, Let your Thummim and your Urim be with your holy one, whom you tested at Massah, and with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

verses.kjv: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
verses.decoded: Who said to his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; nor did he acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children: for they have observed your word, and kept your covenant.

verses.kjv: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
verses.decoded: They will teach Jacob your judgments, and Israel your law: they will put incense before you, and whole burnt sacrifice upon your altar.

verses.kjv: Bless, LORD, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
verses.decoded: Bless, Lord, his possessions, and accept the work of his hands; strike down those who rise against him and those who hate him, so that they cannot rise again.

verses.kjv: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the LORD shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
verses.decoded: And concerning Benjamin he said, The one loved by the Lord will live securely beside him; and the Lord will protect him throughout the day, and he will reside between his shoulders.

verses.kjv: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the LORD be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
verses.decoded: And concerning Joseph, he said, 'May his land be blessed by the Lord with the precious things from heaven, with the dew, and with the deep waters that lie beneath.'

verses.kjv: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
verses.decoded: And for the valuable produce brought forth by the sun, and for the valuable things produced by the moon,

verses.kjv: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
verses.decoded: And for the finest produce of the ancient mountains, and for the valuable products of the enduring hills,

verses.kjv: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
verses.decoded: And for the precious things of the earth and its abundance, and for the favor of him who lived in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

verses.kjv: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: His splendor is like that of a firstborn bull, and his horns are like the horns of wild oxen. With them he will push the people together to the ends of the earth. These are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and these are the thousands of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
verses.decoded: And concerning Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in your travels; and, Issachar, in your tents.

verses.kjv: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
verses.decoded: They will summon the people to the mountain; there they will offer righteous sacrifices: because they will draw from the abundance of the seas, and from treasures hidden in the sand.

verses.kjv: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
verses.decoded: And concerning Gad he said, Blessed is he who expands Gad's territory: he lives like a lion, and tears off the arm along with the top of the head.

verses.kjv: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the LORD, and his judgments with Israel.
verses.decoded: And he secured the best portion for himself, because there, in the territory of the lawgiver, he was settled; and he came with the leaders of the people, he carried out the justice of the LORD, and his decisions with Israel.

verses.kjv: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
verses.decoded: And concerning Dan, he said, Dan is a young lion; he will leap from Bashan.

verses.kjv: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the LORD: possess thou the west and the south.
verses.decoded: And concerning Naphtali, he said, Oh Naphtali, satisfied with favor, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess the west and the south.

verses.kjv: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
verses.decoded: And concerning Asher he said, May Asher be blessed with children; may he be acceptable to his relatives, and may he dip his foot in oil.

verses.kjv: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
verses.decoded: Your shoes will be iron and bronze; and as your days are, so will your strength be.

verses.kjv: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
verses.decoded: There is no one like the God of Jeshurun, who rides through the heavens to help you, and in his majesty across the sky.

verses.kjv: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
verses.decoded: The eternal God is your refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he will drive out the enemy from before you; and will say, Destroy them.

verses.kjv: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
verses.decoded: Then Israel will live securely and alone: the people of Jacob will be in a land of grain and new wine; also his skies will drop down dew.

verses.kjv: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
verses.decoded: Happy are you, O Israel: who is like you, O people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, and who is the sword of your excellence! And your enemies will be found to be liars to you; and you will tread upon their high places.

verses.kjv: And Moses went up from the plains of Moab unto the mountain of Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is over against Jericho. And the LORD shewed him all the land of Gilead, unto Dan,
verses.decoded: Then Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, which is across from Jericho. And the Lord showed him all the land

verses.kjv: And all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, unto the utmost sea,
verses.decoded: And all of Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim, and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the farthest sea,

verses.kjv: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, unto Zoar.
verses.decoded: And the south, and the plain of the valley of Jericho, the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

verses.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, This is the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob, saying, I will give it unto thy seed: I have caused thee to see it with thine eyes, but thou shalt not go over thither.
verses.decoded: And the Lord said to him, This is the land which I promised to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, I will give it to your descendants: I have caused you to see it with your eyes.

verses.kjv: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the word of the LORD.
verses.decoded: So Moses, the servant of the LORD, died there in the land of Moab, as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, over against Bethpeor: but no man knoweth of his sepulchre unto this day.
verses.decoded: And he buried him in a valley in the land of Moab, opposite Beth-peor; but no one knows of his burial place to this day.

verses.kjv: And Moses was an hundred and twenty years old when he died: his eye was not dim, nor his natural force abated.
verses.decoded: Moses was one hundred and twenty years old when he died; his eyesight was not weak, nor had his natural strength diminished.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days: so the days of weeping and mourning for Moses were ended.
verses.decoded: And the people of Israel mourned for Moses in the plains of Moab for thirty days; so the days of mourning and grieving for Moses concluded.

verses.kjv: And Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom; for Moses had laid his hands upon him: and the children of Israel hearkened unto him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.decoded: And Joshua, the son of Nun, was filled with the spirit of wisdom, because Moses had placed his hands on him. And the children of Israel listened to him and did what the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.kjv: And there arose not a prophet since in Israel like unto Moses, whom the LORD knew face to face,
verses.decoded: And there has not arisen a prophet since in Israel like Moses, whom the Lord knew face to face,

verses.kjv: In all the signs and the wonders, which the LORD sent him to do in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
verses.decoded: In all the miraculous signs and wonders that the LORD sent him to perform in the land of Egypt against Pharaoh, and against all his servants, and against all his land,

verses.kjv: And in all that mighty hand, and in all the great terror which Moses shewed in the sight of all Israel.
verses.decoded: And in all those powerful deeds, and in all the great awe that Moses demonstrated in the presence of all Israel.
